types.summary: 取操作数的绝对值（只用 left）。
pitfalls: 任一侧为空（NaN）结果即为空，比较条件不成立。
在主周期上逐根运算；自身写 timeframe 不生效，要高周期的量就把 timeframe 写在操作数指标上。

en.summary: Absolute value of the operand (uses left only).
pitfalls: If either side is empty (NaN) the result is empty and the comparison is false.
Computed bar by bar on the primary timeframe; a timeframe on this node has no effect. For a higher-timeframe quantity, put timeframe on the operand indicator.

types.summary: 量价配合的累积指标，判断资金流向与主力意图。
pitfalls: A/D 线在横盘震荡市中会频繁发出错误信号，背离后可能继续背离，盲目抄底会被埋
极端行情（如连续涨停/跌停）时，A/D 线可能失真，因为价格被锁在极值附近
A/D 线是累积指标，数值本身没有固定范围，不同股票不能直接比较，只能看自身趋势和背离

en.summary: Cumulative price-volume indicator used to judge money flow and the intent of large players.
pitfalls: In sideways markets the A/D line gives frequent false signals; a divergence can keep diverging, and bottom-fishing on it alone gets punished.
In extreme moves (e.g. consecutive limit-up/limit-down days) the A/D line can be distorted because price is pinned at the limit.
A/D is cumulative and has no fixed range; values are not comparable across stocks. Use only its own trend and divergences.

types.summary: 两个操作数逐根相加。
pitfalls: 任一侧为空（NaN）结果即为空，比较条件不成立。
在主周期上逐根运算；自身写 timeframe 不生效，要高周期的量就把 timeframe 写在操作数指标上。

en.summary: Adds two operands bar by bar.
pitfalls: If either side is empty (NaN) the result is empty and the comparison is false.
Computed bar by bar on the primary timeframe; a timeframe on this node has no effect. For a higher-timeframe quantity, put timeframe on the operand indicator.

params.description: 方向线 DI 的计算周期。
ADX 平滑周期；省略时使用与 diPeriod 相关的默认构造。

types.summary: 衡量趋势强弱的指标，不指方向只看力度。
pitfalls: ADX 只测强弱不测方向，单独看 ADX 上升就买卖会两头挨打
ADX 在趋势末期可能仍很高，但价格已到顶/底，容易追高或杀跌
参数周期太短（如 7）会导致 ADX 频繁跳动，假信号增多

en.summary: Measures trend strength, not direction.
pitfalls: ADX measures strength, not direction; trading on a rising ADX alone loses both ways.
ADX can stay high late in a trend while price is already topping or bottoming, which invites chasing.
A very short period (e.g. 7) makes ADX jumpy and adds false signals.

params.adxPeriod: ADX smoothing period; when omitted, a default derived from diPeriod is used.

长均线

types.summary: DIF 的 m 日均线。

en.summary: m-day moving average of DIF.

types.summary: 人气指标：开盘后的多空力量。
pitfalls: 开盘价被操纵（如集合竞价异常）时失真

en.summary: Sentiment indicator: buying vs selling pressure relative to the open.
pitfalls: Distorted when the open is manipulated (e.g. an abnormal call auction).

params.description: Aroon Down 窗口长度。

types.summary: 衡量价格创N日新低的强度，判断下跌趋势是否持续。
pitfalls: 在横盘震荡行情中，Aroon Down 会频繁在 0-100 之间乱跳，产生大量假信号
Aroon Down 只反映「新低」的时效性，不反映跌幅大小——连续小阴线也能让指标维持高位
参数 N 选太小（如 10）会过于敏感，容易追在短期低点；选太大（如 50）则反应迟钝

en.summary: Measures how recently price made an N-bar low, i.e. whether a downtrend persists.
pitfalls: In sideways markets Aroon Down jumps between 0 and 100 and produces many false signals.
Aroon Down reflects how recent the new low is, not how big the decline is; a run of small down bars keeps it high.
A small N (e.g. 10) is over-sensitive and buys short-term lows too eagerly; a large N (e.g. 50) reacts too slowly.

params.period: Aroon Down window length.

params.description: Aroon 振荡器窗口（Up−Down）。

types.summary: 衡量趋势的强弱和持续性，通过时间位置判断方向。
pitfalls: 在横盘震荡市中，Aroon 振荡器会频繁穿越 0 轴，产生大量假信号，让你反复止损
它只考虑最高价和最低价的位置，忽略收盘价，所以极端影线可能误导判断
参数周期 N 太小时，指标过于敏感，噪音多；太大时，反应迟钝，错过最佳入场点

en.summary: Trend strength and persistence from the timing of highs and lows.
pitfalls: In sideways markets the oscillator crosses 0 often, producing false signals and repeated stop-outs.
Uses only the positions of highs and lows and ignores the close, so extreme wicks can mislead.
A small N is noisy; a large N reacts late and misses entries.

params.period: Aroon Oscillator window (Up − Down).

params.description: Aroon Up 窗口长度。

types.summary: 衡量价格创N日新高的速度，判断上升趋势强弱。
pitfalls: 横盘震荡时 Aroon Up 会频繁上下穿越 50，产生大量假信号
指标只看「创新高」不看幅度，如果价格缓慢爬升但总创新高，Aroon Up 依然很高，容易让人忽视回调风险

en.summary: Measures how recently price made an N-bar high, i.e. the strength of an uptrend.
pitfalls: In sideways markets Aroon Up crosses 50 frequently and produces false signals.
It looks at new highs, not their size: a slow grind that keeps making highs keeps Aroon Up high and hides pullback risk.

params.period: Aroon Up window length.

params.description: 平均真实波幅 ATR 的周期。用于该指标计算所回溯的 K 线根数（周期越大曲线越平滑、滞后越大）。

types.summary: 平均真实波幅，衡量股票的「日均波动幅度」，是风控和止损的基石。
pitfalls: ATR 不指方向，单独用毫无意义，必须配合趋势指标
暴跌或大涨后 ATR 会被拉得很高，用它做止损可能被「震出场」
不同股票的 ATR 数量级差异极大（茅台 vs 创业板小盘股），跨标的策略要用 ATR% 标准化

en.summary: Average True Range: the typical bar-to-bar range of a stock; the basis of risk control and stops.
pitfalls: ATR has no direction and is meaningless alone; combine it with a trend indicator.
After a crash or spike ATR is inflated, and stops based on it may get shaken out.
ATR magnitudes differ hugely across stocks; for cross-sectional strategies normalise it as ATR%.

params.period: ATR period: number of bars looked back (larger is smoother and lags more).

params.description: ATR / 收盘价 × 100，用于跨品种波动过滤。

types.summary: ATR 除以价格，标准化波动率，方便跨股对比。
pitfalls: 低价股（比如 1 元以下）的 ATR% 可能虚高，因为价格基数小，实际波动金额不大
停牌后复牌的股票 ATR% 会突然暴增，不要直接用来止损，等几天稳定再说
ATR% 本身不指方向，不能单独做买卖信号，必须配合趋势指标

en.summary: ATR divided by price: normalised volatility comparable across stocks.
pitfalls: ATR% of very low-priced stocks (e.g. below 1 yuan) can look inflated because the price base is small.
ATR% spikes right after a trading halt ends; wait a few days before using it for stops.
ATR% has no direction and is not a trading signal on its own; combine it with a trend indicator.

params.period: ATR / close × 100, for volatility filtering across instruments.

types.summary: 衡量最近5根K线与34根K线动量差值的震荡指标。
pitfalls: 横盘震荡时柱子频繁变色，容易产生假信号，胜率很低
零轴附近柱子很矮时信号意义弱，容易追高或杀跌
AO只看价格中位，忽略成交量，单用容易被骗线

en.summary: Oscillator: momentum of the last 5 bars minus that of the last 34 bars.
pitfalls: In sideways markets the histogram flips colour often; false signals and a low hit rate.
Near the zero line, short bars carry little meaning and invite chasing.
AO uses only the median price and ignores volume; used alone it is easy to fool.

params.description: 均线 1
均线 2
均线 3
均线 4

types.summary: 3/6/12/24 日均线的平均，价格在其上方偏多、下方偏空。
pitfalls: 本质是均线，震荡市反复穿越

en.summary: Average of the 3/6/12/24-day moving averages; price above it leans bullish, below leans bearish.
pitfalls: It is a moving average at heart and is crossed back and forth in ranges.

params.description: 均线周期。

types.summary: 价格偏离 N 日均线的百分比，偏离过大常有回归。
pitfalls: 强势股可以长时间保持高乖离，单独做空 / 卖出容易卖飞
不同波动率的股票合理区间不同，阈值要按股票调

en.summary: Percent deviation of price from its N-day moving average; large deviations often revert.
pitfalls: Strong stocks can stay far above their average for a long time; shorting or selling on BIAS alone exits too early.
Reasonable ranges differ with volatility; tune thresholds per stock.

params.period: Moving-average period.

params.description: 中轨与标准差计算所用的周期。
下轨 = 中轨 − k×标准差。

types.summary: 布林带的下轨，通常代表超卖区域或支撑位。
pitfalls: 单边下跌行情中，价格会沿着下轨持续下行，此时抄底会被套牢
下轨只是统计边界，不是绝对支撑，价格可以长期在下轨下方运行
横盘震荡时，价格反复触碰下轨但无实质反弹，容易产生假信号

en.summary: Lower Bollinger band, usually read as oversold territory or support.
pitfalls: In a one-way decline price rides down the lower band; bottom-fishing there gets trapped.
The lower band is a statistical boundary, not hard support; price can stay below it for long.
In sideways markets price touches the lower band repeatedly without a real bounce, giving false signals.

params.period: Period used for the middle band and the standard deviation.

params.description: 布林带中轨 SMA 周期。用于该指标计算所回溯的 K 线根数（周期越大曲线越平滑、滞后越大）。

types.summary: 布林带中轨 = N 周期 SMA，配合上下轨判断「价格是否偏离常态」。
pitfalls: 单边强趋势市场，价格会持续沿上轨或下轨运行，用通道反转必死
中轨周期太短（< 10）噪声大，太长（> 30）滞后明显，20 是经典折中
默认 2 倍标准差适合大盘股，小盘股波动大可考虑 2.5-3

en.summary: Bollinger middle band = N-period SMA; with the outer bands it shows whether price has left its normal range.
pitfalls: In strong one-way trends price rides the upper or lower band; trading reversals at the bands fails.
A middle-band period under 10 is noisy, over 30 lags; 20 is the classic compromise.
The default 2 standard deviations suits large caps; for volatile small caps consider 2.5–3.

params.period: Bollinger middle band SMA period: number of bars looked back (larger is smoother and lags more).

params.description: 中轨与标准差计算所用的周期。
上轨 = 中轨 + k×标准差。

types.summary: 布林带的上轨，代表股价的「压力线」，突破可能意味着强势或泡沫。
pitfalls: 在单边大涨行情中，股价会长时间贴着上轨运行，此时卖出会踏空大段利润
横盘震荡时上轨会频繁被触碰又回落，容易产生假突破，导致反复止损
参数设置不当（如周期太短或倍数太小）会导致上轨过于敏感，信号过多

en.summary: Upper Bollinger band: the resistance line; a break above can mean strength or a bubble.
pitfalls: In a strong rally price can hug the upper band for long; selling there misses much of the move.
In sideways markets the upper band is touched and rejected often, producing false breakouts and repeated stops.
Poor settings (too short a period or too small a multiplier) make the band over-sensitive with too many signals.

params.period: Period used for the middle band and the standard deviation.

params.description: 周期
标准差倍数

types.summary: 布林上下轨之间的宽度占中轨的百分比，衡量波动收敛与扩张。
pitfalls: 只说波动大小、不说方向

en.summary: Width between the upper and lower bands as a percent of the middle band: volatility contraction and expansion.
pitfalls: Measures volatility size only, not direction.

params.period: Period

params.description: 周期

types.summary: 意愿指标：相对昨收的多空力量。

en.summary: Willingness indicator: buying vs selling pressure relative to the previous close.

types.summary: 当日炸板次数（封住→买一跌破涨停价的跃迁数）。
pitfalls: 盘中重启会丢失当日累计（状态在内存），重启后从 0 重新数
只有进了盘口采集集的标的才有值，其余恒 NaN（比较兜底 false，不会误触发）
★ 求值频率目前仍是 bar 收盘（1/分钟），适合做「现在是什么状态」的确认，不适合捕捉「刚刚发生了什么」跃迁

en.summary: Number of times the limit-up board broke today (transitions from sealed to bid-1 falling below the limit price).
pitfalls: An intraday restart loses the running count (state is in memory); counting restarts from 0.
Only symbols in the order-book capture set have values; others are always NaN (comparisons fall back to false and never fire).
★ Evaluation still happens at bar close (once a minute): good for confirming the current state, not for catching a transition that just happened.

types.summary: 一根 bar 内 撤单额/委托额。真封与假封的分水岭。需逐笔委托/成交。
pitfalls: 只有进了逐笔订阅集（≤50 只）的标的才有值，其余恒 NaN
分母是委托额，冷清时段样本极少、比值跳动剧烈
阈值尚未标定，切勿直接照抄示例里的数字

en.summary: Cancelled amount / ordered amount within one bar; separates genuine limit-up seals from fake ones. Needs tick-by-tick orders and trades.
pitfalls: Only symbols in the tick-by-tick subscription set (≤ 50) have values; others are always NaN.
The denominator is order amount; in quiet periods the sample is tiny and the ratio jumps around.
Thresholds are not calibrated yet; do not copy the numbers in the examples.

types.summary: 一根大阴线吃掉前一根阳线，典型的顶部反转信号。
pitfalls: 在震荡市或下跌趋势中出现的看跌吞没，往往只是假信号，容易追空被套
如果第二根阴线实体不够大（只比阳线实体大一点点），反转成功率会大幅下降
必须等收盘确认，盘中看到阴线吞没阳线就入场，容易被尾盘拉升打脸

en.summary: A large down bar swallows the previous up bar; a classic top-reversal signal.
pitfalls: Bearish engulfing in a range or an existing downtrend is often a false signal; shorting it gets trapped.
If the second bar's body is barely larger than the up bar's body, reversal odds drop sharply.
Wait for the close to confirm; entering intraday on an apparent engulfing gets caught by late rallies.

types.summary: 两根K线组成的看跌反转形态，预示上涨可能结束。
pitfalls: 在横盘震荡市中频繁出现，但多数是假信号，盲目卖出会被来回打脸
单根形态胜率有限，必须等下一根K线确认（比如跌破孕线最低点）再行动
小周期（如5分钟）的孕线噪音极大，尽量在日线或周线使用

en.summary: Two-bar bearish reversal pattern suggesting an advance may be ending.
pitfalls: Frequent in sideways markets, mostly as false signals; selling on it blindly gets whipsawed.
A single pattern has limited edge; wait for confirmation (e.g. a break of the harami low).
On small timeframes (e.g. 5m) harami is very noisy; prefer daily or weekly.

params.description: 实体 ÷ 开盘价 ≥ 它，排除开盘即最高的小阴线。

types.summary: 开盘即最高、收盘即最低，没有上下影线，卖方全程主导、价格一路下跌。
pitfalls: 低位恐慌盘也常出现，未必继续跌

en.summary: Opens at the high and closes at the low with no shadows: sellers in control throughout.
pitfalls: Also common in capitulation at lows; it does not guarantee further declines.

params.bodyPct: Body ÷ open must be at least this, to exclude tiny bars that merely open at the high.

types.summary: 一根阴线后出现一根更大的阳线，完全包住前一根，预示上涨。
pitfalls: 在上涨趋势中或横盘震荡中出现的看涨吞没，信号可靠性大幅降低，容易追高被套
两根K线实体都很小（如十字星后的小阳线），吞没形态意义不大，常是假信号
必须等阳线收盘确认，盘中看到阳线覆盖阴线就追入，尾盘可能回落失败

en.summary: A larger up bar fully covers the previous down bar, suggesting a rise.
pitfalls: Bullish engulfing inside an uptrend or a range is much less reliable and invites chasing.
If both bodies are tiny (e.g. a small up bar after a doji) the pattern means little and is often false.
Wait for the up bar to close; buying intraday may fail into the close.

types.summary: 两根K线组成的底部反转信号，预示下跌可能结束。
pitfalls: 单根形态胜率不高，尤其在震荡市中经常是假信号，必须等后续确认
第二根K线实体越小，反转力度可能越弱，小十字星形态容易失效
大趋势向下时，看涨孕线可能只是反弹中继，很快继续下跌

en.summary: Two-bar bottom-reversal signal suggesting a decline may be ending.
pitfalls: Low hit rate on its own, especially in ranges; wait for confirmation.
The smaller the second body, the weaker the reversal; tiny doji versions often fail.
In a major downtrend a bullish harami may only mark a pause before further declines.

params.description: 实体 ÷ 开盘价 ≥ 它，排除开盘即最低的小阳线。

types.summary: 开盘即最低、收盘即最高，没有上下影线，买方全程主导、价格一路上扬。
pitfalls: 高位连续光头阳线也可能是加速赶顶

en.summary: Opens at the low and closes at the high with no shadows: buyers in control throughout.
pitfalls: Consecutive marubozu at high levels can also be a blow-off top.

params.bodyPct: Body ÷ open must be at least this, to exclude tiny bars that merely open at the low.

params.description: 参与判定的连续 K 线根数。
实体相对波幅的比例阈值。

types.summary: 开盘收盘价几乎相同，形态像十字，代表多空力量平衡。
pitfalls: 十字星在趋势中途出现时，经常只是「空中加油」，继续原方向，盲目反向操作会被打脸
单根十字星信号很弱，必须结合前后K线确认，否则假信号极多
参数「根数」设太大（如5根以上），信号太少，错过行情；设太小（1根），信号太多，全是噪音

en.summary: Open and close almost equal, forming a cross: buyers and sellers in balance.
pitfalls: A doji mid-trend is often just a pause; trading against the trend on it gets punished.
A single doji is a weak signal; confirm with surrounding bars or expect many false signals.
Too many bars (5+) gives too few signals; 1 bar gives too many, mostly noise.

params.bodyFactor: Threshold for body size relative to the bar's range.

params.description: 长实体阈值：实体 ÷ 开盘价（0.02 = 2%）。
中间那根的小实体阈值（0.008 = 0.8%）。

types.summary: 长阳 → 小实体 → 长阴收破第一根实体中点，上涨末端的见顶组合。
pitfalls: A 股日线真跳空少，中间那根按「实体不和第 1 根实体重叠」判，比教科书宽
单独当买卖点胜率不高，配合位置（低位 / 高位）和成交量用

en.summary: Long up bar → small body → long down bar closing below the midpoint of the first body: a topping combination.
pitfalls: True gaps are rare on A-share daily bars; the middle bar only needs a body that does not overlap the first body, looser than the textbook.
Weak as a stand-alone entry or exit; use with location (high/low) and volume.

params.smallBodyPct: Small-body threshold for the middle bar (0.008 = 0.8%).

types.summary: 底部反转的蜡烛形态，像一把锤子。
pitfalls: 锤子线本身不是买入信号，需要次日确认（比如收阳线或高开），否则可能只是下跌中继
在上涨趋势中出现的锤子线（称为「吊颈线」）反而是见顶信号，新手容易混淆
成交量太小或处于横盘震荡区间的锤子线，反转概率很低，容易假突破

en.summary: Bottom-reversal candle shaped like a hammer.
pitfalls: A hammer is not a buy signal by itself; wait for next-day confirmation (an up close or a gap up), or it may be a pause in a decline.
The same shape in an uptrend is a hanging man, a top signal; beginners confuse the two.
Hammers on low volume or inside a range rarely reverse and often fail.

types.summary: 一根带长下影线的小实体K线，预示上涨行情可能反转。
pitfalls: 上吊线单独出现时可靠性不高，必须等第二天确认，否则容易被假信号骗
在强势上涨中，上吊线可能只是短暂回调，随后继续上涨，过早卖出会踏空
如果上吊线出现在震荡区间顶部，信号会大打折扣，因为本身就没有明确趋势

en.summary: Small body with a long lower shadow, suggesting an uptrend may reverse.
pitfalls: Unreliable alone; wait for next-day confirmation.
In a strong rally it may be a brief dip; selling early misses the rest of the move.
At the top of a range the signal is much weaker because there is no clear trend.

types.summary: 底部反转信号，像倒过来的锤子，预示可能见底反弹。
pitfalls: 单根K线形态可靠性较低，必须等次日确认，否则容易是下跌中继
上影线越长越好，但如果实体太大或上下影线都长，就不是标准倒锤线
在强势下跌趋势中，倒锤线可能只是短暂反弹，随后继续暴跌

en.summary: Bottom-reversal signal shaped like an upside-down hammer, suggesting a possible rebound.
pitfalls: Single-bar patterns are unreliable; wait for next-day confirmation or it may be a pause in a decline.
Longer upper shadows are better, but with a large body or long shadows on both ends it is not a proper inverted hammer.
In a strong downtrend it may be only a brief bounce before further declines.

params.description: 进岛、出岛两个缺口的最小幅度。
孤岛最多多少根 K 线。

types.summary: 向下跳空形成孤岛，随后向上跳空离开，强烈见底信号。
pitfalls: 日线上较少见

en.summary: A gap down forms an island, then a gap up leaves it: a strong bottom signal.
pitfalls: Rare on daily bars.

params.minGapPct: Minimum size of the gaps into and out of the island.
params.lookback: Maximum number of bars on the island.

params.description: 进岛、出岛两个缺口的最小幅度。
孤岛最多多少根 K 线。

types.summary: 向上跳空形成孤岛，随后向下跳空离开，两边留下缺口，强烈见顶信号。
pitfalls: 日线上较少见；缺口阈值过小会把普通跳空算进来

en.summary: A gap up forms an island, then a gap down leaves it, with gaps on both sides: a strong top signal.
pitfalls: Rare on daily bars; a gap threshold that is too small counts ordinary gaps.

params.minGapPct: Minimum size of the gaps into and out of the island.
params.lookback: Maximum number of bars on the island.

params.description: 长实体阈值：实体 ÷ 开盘价（0.02 = 2%）。
中间那根的小实体阈值（0.008 = 0.8%）。

types.summary: 长阴 → 小实体 → 长阳收过第一根实体中点，下跌末端的见底组合。
pitfalls: A 股日线真跳空少，中间那根按「实体不和第 1 根实体重叠」判，比教科书宽
单独当买卖点胜率不高，配合位置（低位 / 高位）和成交量用

en.summary: Long down bar → small body → long up bar closing above the midpoint of the first body: a bottoming combination.
pitfalls: True gaps are rare on A-share daily bars; the middle bar only needs a body that does not overlap the first body, looser than the textbook.
Weak as a stand-alone entry or exit; use with location (high/low) and volume.

params.smallBodyPct: Small-body threshold for the middle bar (0.008 = 0.8%).

types.summary: 单根K线形态，高位出现长上影预示见顶。
pitfalls: 流星线单独使用胜率不高，必须等次日确认（如低开或收阴），否则容易被假信号坑
在震荡市中或上涨初期出现，可能只是正常回调，直接卖出会踏空
上影线不够长（小于实体2倍）或下影线太长，就不是标准流星线，信号失效

en.summary: Single-bar pattern: a long upper shadow at a high suggests a top.
pitfalls: Low hit rate alone; wait for next-day confirmation (a lower open or a down close).
In a range or early in an advance it may be a normal pullback; selling on it misses the move.
If the upper shadow is short (less than 2× the body) or the lower shadow is long, it is not a proper shooting star.

params.description: 实体 ÷ 全长 ≤ 它。

types.summary: 小实体、上下影线都比实体长，多空拉锯、方向待定。
pitfalls: 单独意义不大，要看出现的位置

en.summary: Small body with both shadows longer than the body: a tug of war with no clear direction.
pitfalls: Means little alone; location matters.

params.bodyRatio: Body ÷ full range must be at most this.

types.summary: 连续三根阴线，预示上涨行情可能反转。
pitfalls: 在下跌趋势中出现的三只乌鸦可能是持续信号，而非反转，容易抄底被套
阴线实体不够大或带有长下影线时，信号可靠性降低，容易假信号
单看形态不结合趋势和成交量，胜率可能不足50%

en.summary: Three consecutive down bars, suggesting an advance may reverse.
pitfalls: Inside a downtrend it may signal continuation rather than reversal; bottom-fishing gets trapped.
Small bodies or long lower shadows reduce reliability.
Without trend and volume context the hit rate can be under 50%.

types.summary: 连续三根大阳线，预示上涨趋势强劲。
pitfalls: 在连续大涨后的高位出现三白兵，可能是主力拉高出货的陷阱，追高容易被套
如果三根阳线实体越来越小或带有长上影线，说明上涨乏力，形态可靠性降低
横盘震荡市中频繁出现类似形态，但很快被阴线吞没，容易造成假突破

en.summary: Three consecutive large up bars, suggesting a strong uptrend.
pitfalls: After a big run-up it can be a distribution trap; chasing gets trapped.
Shrinking bodies or long upper shadows signal fading momentum and lower reliability.
In ranges similar shapes appear often and are quickly engulfed, producing false breakouts.

params.description: 两根最低价相差不超过的比例。
前 N 根累计下跌才算「下跌之后」。

types.summary: 下跌之后两根 K 线最低价几乎相同、先阴后阳，下方有支撑。
pitfalls: 容差太大会遍地命中

en.summary: After a decline, two bars with nearly equal lows, down then up: support below.
pitfalls: Too large a tolerance matches almost everywhere.

params.tolerancePct: Maximum relative difference between the two lows.
params.lookback: The previous N bars must have declined in total to count as 'after a decline'.

params.description: 两根最高价相差不超过的比例（0.003 = 0.3%）。
前 N 根累计上涨才算「上涨之后」。

types.summary: 上涨之后两根 K 线最高价几乎相同、先阳后阴，上方有压力。
pitfalls: 容差太大会遍地命中

en.summary: After an advance, two bars with nearly equal highs, up then down: resistance above.
pitfalls: Too large a tolerance matches almost everywhere.

params.tolerancePct: Maximum relative difference between the two highs (0.003 = 0.3%).
params.lookback: The previous N bars must have advanced in total to count as 'after an advance'.

params.description: 典型商品通道指标周期。

types.summary: 衡量价格相对统计位置，判断超买超卖的震荡指标。
pitfalls: 在强趋势行情中，CCI会长时间停留在超买或超卖区，过早反向操作会导致巨大亏损
CCI对价格突变非常敏感，一根大阳线或大阴线就能让数值剧烈变化，容易产生假信号
不同股票或周期的CCI阈值（+100/-100）并非万能，需要根据品种特性调整

en.summary: Oscillator measuring price relative to its statistical mean, for overbought/oversold.
pitfalls: In strong trends CCI can stay overbought or oversold for long; fading it early causes large losses.
CCI is very sensitive to sudden moves; one large bar swings it and creates false signals.
The ±100 thresholds are not universal; adjust per instrument and timeframe.

params.period: Commodity Channel Index period.

params.description: 可选；指定时须同时指定 slow，且 slow>fast。
可选；未指定时使用 Ta4j 默认 Chaikin 振荡器参数。

types.summary: 量价配合的动量指标，判断资金流入流出强度。
pitfalls: 在震荡行情中频繁穿越零轴，信号噪音极大，容易反复止损
背离信号在强单边趋势中可能连续出现多次假信号，等真反转时已经亏了好几笔
对成交量异常放大的个股（如庄股）极度敏感，容易误判资金意图

en.summary: Price-volume momentum indicator for the strength of money inflow and outflow.
pitfalls: In ranges it crosses zero often; very noisy and leads to repeated stops.
In strong one-way trends divergences can fail several times before a real reversal.
Extremely sensitive to abnormal volume (e.g. heavily controlled stocks), which misleads about money flow.

params.fast: Optional; if set, slow must also be set and slow > fast.
params.slow: Optional; when omitted the Ta4j default Chaikin Oscillator parameters are used.

params.description: 平滑
比较间隔

types.summary: 高低价差的 EMA 相对 m 根前的变化率。

en.summary: Rate of change of the EMA of the high-low range versus m bars ago.

params.description: CMF 汇总窗口长度。

types.summary: 结合价格位置和成交量，衡量资金流入流出强度的指标。
pitfalls: CMF 在震荡市中频繁穿越 0 轴，容易产生假信号，最好结合趋势指标过滤
CMF 对成交量异常敏感，如果某天出现极端放量（如乌龙指），指标会瞬间失真
CMF 是滞后指标，等它跌破 0 时股价可能已经跌了不少，不适合做短线逃顶

en.summary: Combines where price closes in its range with volume to measure money inflow and outflow.
pitfalls: In ranges CMF crosses 0 often; filter it with a trend indicator.
CMF is very sensitive to volume; one extreme volume day (e.g. a fat-finger trade) distorts it.
CMF lags; by the time it drops below 0 price may have fallen a lot, so it is poor for short-term exits at tops.

params.period: CMF summation window.

params.description: 周期

types.summary: 上涨幅度与下跌幅度之差占总幅度的比例，范围 −100~100。
pitfalls: 与 RSI 同类，二选一即可

en.summary: Sum of gains minus sum of losses as a share of total movement, range −100 to 100.
pitfalls: Same family as RSI; use one or the other.

params.period: Period

params.description: 统计窗口（根数）。

types.summary: 以昨日中间价为基准，比较多空力量。
pitfalls: N 日内全部高于昨中价时分母为 0，值为空

en.summary: Compares buying and selling strength against the previous bar's mid price.
pitfalls: If every bar in N is above the previous mid price, the denominator is 0 and the value is empty.

params.period: Window (bars).

types.summary: 今日至今各根成交额之和（元）。
pitfalls: 当日任一根 K 线缺成交额（部分数据源不带，如美股）时为空，不给少算了的数。
换手率请用 DAY_TURNOVER_PCT（成交量 ÷ 流通股本），不需要成交额。
需要上一个完整交易日才有值：序列的第一个交易日一律为空。

en.summary: Sum of traded value of today's bars so far (yuan).
pitfalls: Empty if any bar today lacks traded value (some sources, e.g. US equities, do not provide it), rather than reporting an undercount.
For turnover rate use DAY_TURNOVER_PCT (volume ÷ free float), which does not need traded value.
Needs a previous complete trading day: the first trading day in the series is always empty.

types.summary: (今日最高 − 今日最低) / 昨收 × 100。
pitfalls: 需要上一个完整交易日才有值：序列的第一个交易日（暖机截断、多半不完整）一律为空，暖机按 3 个交易日折算。
价格与主序列同一复权口径；百分比一律以昨收为分母。

en.summary: (today's high − today's low) / previous close × 100.
pitfalls: Needs a previous complete trading day: the first trading day in the series (cut by warm-up, usually incomplete) is always empty; warm-up counts as 3 trading days.
Prices use the same adjustment as the primary series; percentages always use the previous close as denominator.

params.description: 与昨收/开盘/最高/最低/均价比较时，「现价」取当根 K 线的哪个价。默认收盘价；判「盘中触及过」用最低价（回落）或最高价（反弹）。

types.summary: 现价相对昨收的涨跌幅（%）。
pitfalls: 需要上一个完整交易日才有值：序列的第一个交易日（暖机截断、多半不完整）一律为空，暖机按 3 个交易日折算。
价格与主序列同一复权口径；百分比一律以昨收为分母。

en.summary: Change of the current price versus the previous close (%).
pitfalls: Needs a previous complete trading day: the first trading day in the series (cut by warm-up, usually incomplete) is always empty; warm-up counts as 3 trading days.
Prices use the same adjustment as the primary series; percentages always use the previous close as denominator.

params.price: Which price of the current bar is 'current price' when comparing with previous close/open/high/low/average. Defaults to close; to test 'touched intraday' use low (pullback) or high (rebound).

types.summary: 今日至今最高价（含当根）。
pitfalls: 含当根：close > DAY_HIGH 永远不成立，突破新高请用 DAY_HIGH_BEFORE。
需要上一个完整交易日才有值：序列的第一个交易日（暖机截断、多半不完整）一律为空，暖机按 3 个交易日折算。
价格与主序列同一复权口径；百分比一律以昨收为分母。

en.summary: Highest price today so far (including the current bar).
pitfalls: Includes the current bar: close > DAY_HIGH can never hold; for a new-high breakout use DAY_HIGH_BEFORE.
Needs a previous complete trading day: the first trading day in the series (cut by warm-up, usually incomplete) is always empty; warm-up counts as 3 trading days.
Prices use the same adjustment as the primary series; percentages always use the previous close as denominator.

types.summary: 今日在当根之前的最高价（不含当根）；当日首根为空。
pitfalls: 需要上一个完整交易日才有值：序列的第一个交易日（暖机截断、多半不完整）一律为空，暖机按 3 个交易日折算。
价格与主序列同一复权口径；百分比一律以昨收为分母。

en.summary: Highest price today before the current bar (excluding it); empty on the first bar of the day.
pitfalls: Needs a previous complete trading day: the first trading day in the series (cut by warm-up, usually incomplete) is always empty; warm-up counts as 3 trading days.
Prices use the same adjustment as the primary series; percentages always use the previous close as denominator.

types.summary: 今日至今最低价（含当根）。
pitfalls: 含当根：close < DAY_LOW 永远不成立，跌破新低请用 DAY_LOW_BEFORE。
需要上一个完整交易日才有值：序列的第一个交易日（暖机截断、多半不完整）一律为空，暖机按 3 个交易日折算。
价格与主序列同一复权口径；百分比一律以昨收为分母。

en.summary: Lowest price today so far (including the current bar).
pitfalls: Includes the current bar: close < DAY_LOW can never hold; for a new-low break use DAY_LOW_BEFORE.
Needs a previous complete trading day: the first trading day in the series (cut by warm-up, usually incomplete) is always empty; warm-up counts as 3 trading days.
Prices use the same adjustment as the primary series; percentages always use the previous close as denominator.

types.summary: 今日在当根之前的最低价（不含当根）；当日首根为空。
pitfalls: 需要上一个完整交易日才有值：序列的第一个交易日（暖机截断、多半不完整）一律为空，暖机按 3 个交易日折算。
价格与主序列同一复权口径；百分比一律以昨收为分母。

en.summary: Lowest price today before the current bar (excluding it); empty on the first bar of the day.
pitfalls: Needs a previous complete trading day: the first trading day in the series (cut by warm-up, usually incomplete) is always empty; warm-up counts as 3 trading days.
Prices use the same adjustment as the primary series; percentages always use the previous close as denominator.

labels.zh: 当日累积主力净额 · L2

types.summary: 开盘以来「大单主动买额 − 大单主动卖额」的累积，单位元。
pitfalls: 「当日」实际是「自本系统订阅它以来」：盘中才加入的票不是全天累积

en.summary: Cumulative large-order aggressive buy value minus aggressive sell value since the open, in yuan.
pitfalls: 'Today' really means 'since this system subscribed to it': symbols added intraday do not have a full-day total.

types.summary: 当日首根之后，high 严格高于此前当日最高的根数。
pitfalls: 需要上一个完整交易日才有值：序列的第一个交易日（暖机截断、多半不完整）一律为空，暖机按 3 个交易日折算。
价格与主序列同一复权口径；百分比一律以昨收为分母。

en.summary: Number of bars after the first bar of the day whose high is strictly above the day's prior high.
pitfalls: Needs a previous complete trading day: the first trading day in the series (cut by warm-up, usually incomplete) is always empty; warm-up counts as 3 trading days.
Prices use the same adjustment as the primary series; percentages always use the previous close as denominator.

types.summary: 当日首根 K 线的开盘价（A 股即集合竞价价）。
pitfalls: 需要上一个完整交易日才有值：序列的第一个交易日（暖机截断、多半不完整）一律为空，暖机按 3 个交易日折算。
价格与主序列同一复权口径；百分比一律以昨收为分母。

en.summary: Open price of today's first bar (the call-auction price for A-shares).
pitfalls: Needs a previous complete trading day: the first trading day in the series (cut by warm-up, usually incomplete) is always empty; warm-up counts as 3 trading days.
Prices use the same adjustment as the primary series; percentages always use the previous close as denominator.

types.summary: 当日累计量 ÷ 流通股本 × 100。
pitfalls: 依赖 md_stock_daily_basic 的流通股本；缺数据或标的认不出时为空。
需要上一个完整交易日才有值：序列的第一个交易日（暖机截断、多半不完整）一律为空。

en.summary: Today's cumulative volume ÷ free-float shares × 100.
pitfalls: Depends on free-float shares from md_stock_daily_basic; empty when data is missing or the symbol is unrecognised.
Needs a previous complete trading day: the first trading day in the series (cut by warm-up, usually incomplete) is always empty.

types.summary: 今日至今各根成交量之和。
pitfalls: 单位随主序列：分钟线是股，不是手。
需要上一个完整交易日才有值：序列的第一个交易日（暖机截断、多半不完整）一律为空，暖机按 3 个交易日折算。
价格与主序列同一复权口径；百分比一律以昨收为分母。

en.summary: Sum of volume of today's bars so far.
pitfalls: Units follow the primary series: minute bars are in shares, not lots.
Needs a previous complete trading day: the first trading day in the series (cut by warm-up, usually incomplete) is always empty; warm-up counts as 3 trading days.
Prices use the same adjustment as the primary series; percentages always use the previous close as denominator.

params.description: 基准取序列里此前多少个完整交易日（停牌日自然跳过）；凑不齐为空。暖机按 N + 2 个交易日折算。
FULL_DAY＝行情软件量比；SAME_TIME＝与过去 N 日同一时刻的累计量比。

types.summary: A 股量比：今日每分钟均量 ÷ 过去 N 日每分钟均量。
pitfalls: FULL_DAY 口径下开盘几分钟量比天然很大（竞价量 + 开盘放量），开盘段选股建议用 SAME_TIME。
需要上一个完整交易日才有值：序列的第一个交易日（暖机截断、多半不完整）一律为空。

en.summary: A-share volume ratio: today's average volume per minute ÷ the average per minute over the past N days.
pitfalls: With FULL_DAY the ratio is naturally huge in the first minutes (auction volume plus the opening burst); for screening near the open use SAME_TIME.
Needs a previous complete trading day: the first trading day in the series (cut by warm-up, usually incomplete) is always empty.

params.days: Baseline uses this many previous complete trading days in the series (halted days are skipped); empty if not enough. Warm-up counts as N + 2 trading days.
params.baseline: FULL_DAY = the volume ratio shown in quote software; SAME_TIME = ratio to cumulative volume at the same time of day over the past N days.

types.summary: 当日分时均价线 ≈ Σ(典型价 × 量) / Σ量。
pitfalls: 是近似值：真实分时均价＝成交额 / 成交量。
需要上一个完整交易日才有值：序列的第一个交易日（暖机截断、多半不完整）一律为空，暖机按 3 个交易日折算。
价格与主序列同一复权口径；百分比一律以昨收为分母。

en.summary: Intraday average price line ≈ Σ(typical price × volume) / Σ volume.
pitfalls: An approximation: the true intraday average is traded value / volume.
Needs a previous complete trading day: the first trading day in the series (cut by warm-up, usually incomplete) is always empty; warm-up counts as 3 trading days.
Prices use the same adjustment as the primary series; percentages always use the previous close as denominator.

types.summary: 一根 bar 内「大单主动买额 - 大单主动卖额」，单位元。逐笔接入后已切真实计算。
pitfalls: 只有进了逐笔订阅集（≤50 只）的标的才有值，其余恒 NaN（比较兜底 false，不会误触发）
回测/历史区间在逐笔回放接上前恒 NaN——**不要拿回测结果当验证**
单位是元不是手，不同市值股票的绝对值不可横向比较

en.summary: Large-order aggressive buy value minus aggressive sell value within one bar, in yuan. Computed from real tick-by-tick data.
pitfalls: Only symbols in the tick-by-tick subscription set (≤ 50) have values; others are always NaN (comparisons fall back to false and never fire).
Backtests and historical ranges are always NaN until tick-by-tick replay is connected — **do not treat backtest results as validation**.
Units are yuan, not lots; absolute values are not comparable across market caps.

params.description: 双指数移动平均周期。用于该指标计算所回溯的 K 线根数（周期越大曲线越平滑、滞后越大）。

types.summary: 减少滞后性的双指数均线，比普通均线更灵敏。
pitfalls: 在震荡行情中 DEMA 会频繁发出假信号，比普通均线更容易被「左右打脸」
参数周期太小时（如小于 5），DEMA 几乎紧贴价格，失去平滑意义，反而增加噪音

en.summary: Double EMA with less lag, more responsive than an ordinary moving average.
pitfalls: In ranges DEMA gives frequent false signals and whipsaws more than ordinary moving averages.
With a very small period (e.g. under 5) DEMA hugs price, loses its smoothing and adds noise.

params.period: DEMA period: number of bars looked back (larger is smoother and lags more).

types.summary: (Σ买量-Σ卖量)/(Σ买量+Σ卖量)，取值 [-1, 1]。
pitfalls: 档位数取决于行情源能力，只有 L1 的源会退化成 1 档
只有进了盘口采集集的标的才有值，其余恒 NaN（比较兜底 false，不会误触发）

params.description: 唐奇安下轨窗口：取当根之前的 N 根，不含当根。

types.summary: 唐奇安通道的下轨，识别市场最弱支撑位。
pitfalls: 不含当根：「收盘 < 下轨」就是收盘跌破了前 N 根的最低点；其它平台的唐奇安多含当根，对数时差一根
在单边下跌行情中，下轨会不断被跌破，你以为是支撑其实是「无底洞」，抄底容易抄在半山腰
周期设置太短（如 5 天），下轨波动剧烈，频繁被触碰，失去参考意义；周期太长（如 60 天），下轨反应迟钝，等信号出来价格已经跌了一大截

en.summary: Lower edge of the Donchian channel: the weakest support of the market.
pitfalls: Excludes the current bar: 'close < lower band' means the close broke below the lowest low of the previous N bars. Most other platforms include the current bar, so values differ by one bar when compared.
In a one-way decline the lower band keeps breaking; what looks like support is a bottomless pit, and bottom-fishing catches a falling knife.
A short period (e.g. 5 days) makes the band jumpy and touched constantly; a long one (e.g. 60 days) reacts so slowly that price has fallen far before it signals.

params.period: Donchian lower band window: the N bars before the current one, excluding it.

params.description: 唐奇安中轨（高低均值）窗口：取当根之前的 N 根，不含当根。

types.summary: 唐奇安通道的中轨线，本质是过去N天的价格中位数。
pitfalls: 中轨只是价格中心，没有趋势方向判断能力，单独使用容易在震荡市被假突破骗
参数周期越大，中轨越平滑，但反应越迟钝，等它给出信号行情可能已经走完
遇到极端行情（如连续涨停/跌停），中轨会严重滞后，完全失去参考意义

en.summary: Middle line of the Donchian channel: the midpoint of the past N bars' price range.
pitfalls: The middle band is a price centre with no trend direction; alone it is fooled by false breakouts in ranges.
A longer period is smoother but slower; its signal may come after the move is over.
In extreme moves (consecutive limit-up/down days) the middle band lags badly and loses meaning.

params.period: Donchian middle band (mean of high and low) window: the N bars before the current one, excluding it.

params.description: 唐奇安通道回溯根数：取当根之前的 N 根，不含当根。

types.summary: 当根之前 N 根 K 线最高价的最高值（不含当根），构成通道上沿。

横盘震荡时，价格反复突破又跌回上轨，假突破极多，追高容易被套
N 值太小（比如 5）会频繁触发信号，N 值太大（比如 100）则信号稀少，错过行情

en.summary: Highest high of the N bars before the current one (excluding it): the upper edge of the channel.
pitfalls: Excludes the current bar: in a 5-minute strategy, period=20 means 'this 5-minute bar closed above the highest high of the previous 20 five-minute bars'. Most other platforms include the current bar, so values differ by one bar when compared.
In ranges price breaks above and falls back repeatedly; many false breakouts, and chasing gets trapped.
A small N (e.g. 5) fires often; a large N (e.g. 100) rarely fires and misses moves.

params.period: Donchian channel lookback: the N bars before the current one, excluding it.

types.summary: 策略使用26根前的收盘价，对比当前价格，避免绘图位移产生前视。
pitfalls: 延迟线本身不产生买卖信号，必须结合其他指标（如转折线、基准线）使用
在横盘震荡市中，延迟线会频繁上下穿越K线，产生假信号
参数26是默认值，但不同股票或周期可能需要调整，死板用26可能错过信号

en.summary: The strategy uses the close from 26 bars ago against the current price, avoiding the look-ahead created by chart displacement.
pitfalls: The lagging span produces no signal by itself; use it with other components (conversion line, base line).
In sideways markets it crosses the bars often and gives false signals.
26 is the default; other stocks or timeframes may need adjustment.

params.description: 一目均衡表基准线周期。

types.summary: 一目均衡图中的中期趋势线，类似26日均线。
pitfalls: 在震荡市中基准线会频繁被穿越，产生大量假信号，容易追涨杀跌
基准线滞后性比普通26日均线更明显，因为用了最高最低价，对突发行情反应更慢
单独使用基准线效果很差，必须结合转换线、延迟线等一目均衡图其他组件

en.summary: Medium-term trend line of Ichimoku, similar to a 26-day average.
pitfalls: In ranges the base line is crossed often; many false signals invite chasing.
It lags more than a 26-day average because it uses highs and lows and reacts slowly to sudden moves.
Weak alone; combine with the conversion line, lagging span and other Ichimoku components.

types.summary: 用两条线画出未来支撑阻力区，一目均衡的核心。
pitfalls: 因为提前平移了 26 根 K 线，所以信号天然滞后——等价格跌破带 A 时，实际已经跌了不少
在横盘震荡市里，先行带 A 会频繁被上下穿越，产生大量假信号，新手容易反复止损
单独用先行带 A 意义不大，必须结合转换线、基准线和延迟线一起看，否则容易误判

en.summary: Draws the future support/resistance zone with two lines; the core of Ichimoku.
pitfalls: Because it is shifted 26 bars ahead, its signals are inherently late: by the time price breaks span A it has already fallen a lot.
In sideways markets span A is crossed both ways often; beginners get stopped repeatedly.
Span A alone means little; read it with the conversion line, base line and lagging span.

types.summary: 一目均衡图领先线B，构成未来云层下沿。
pitfalls: 先行带B是滞后指标（取过去52天极值平均），在快速单边行情中云层会严重滞后，可能给出错误支撑/阻力位
横盘震荡时云层会变得很宽，价格频繁穿越云层，导致频繁假信号
先行带B画在26天后，意味着你看到的云层是「未来」的，但实际价格可能提前反应，不要死板等价格碰到云层才操作

en.summary: Ichimoku leading span B, the lower edge of the future cloud.
pitfalls: Span B lags (average of 52-day extremes); in fast one-way moves the cloud lags badly and may show wrong support/resistance.
In ranges the cloud gets wide and price crosses it often, giving false signals.
Span B is plotted 26 days ahead, so the cloud you see is 'the future', but price may react early; do not wait rigidly for price to touch the cloud.

params.description: 一目均衡表转换线（短周期高低均）。

types.summary: 一目均衡图中的短期趋势线，类似9日均线但更灵敏。
pitfalls: 在震荡行情中，转换线会频繁上下穿越，导致连续亏损，就像钝刀割肉
转换线只看9根K线，对单根异常K线（如涨停/跌停）反应过度，容易给出假信号
单独用转换线做交易胜率很低，必须结合基准线、云层等其它部分一起看

en.summary: Short-term trend line of Ichimoku, like a 9-day average but more responsive.
pitfalls: In ranges it crosses up and down often, causing a string of small losses.
It looks at only 9 bars and over-reacts to single abnormal bars (e.g. limit-up/limit-down), giving false signals.
Low hit rate alone; read it with the base line and the cloud.

params.tenkan: Ichimoku conversion line (mean of short-period high and low).

params.description: 看哪个指数；默认上证指数。
指数的 N 日均线。

types.summary: 大盘（默认上证指数）离它的 N 日均线有多远，正数表示在均线上方。
pitfalls: 均线有滞后：急跌开始的头几天指数可能还在均线上方
只管开仓，不会替你平掉已有持仓；要跟大盘出场，另在出场条件里加「< 0」
指数日线每天收盘后同步，盘后才有当天值

en.summary: How far the market index (Shanghai Composite by default) is from its N-day average; positive means above it.
pitfalls: The average lags: in the first days of a sharp drop the index may still be above it.
Only gates entries and never closes existing positions; to exit with the market, add '< 0' to the exit condition.
Index daily bars are synced after each close; today's value exists only after the close.

params.index: Which index; Shanghai Composite by default.
params.period: N-day moving average of the index.

params.description: 通常 1m × 240 ≈ 当日全天。
主板 / ST 10、创业板/科创板 20、北交所 30。

types.summary: 衡量涨停后封板有多「稳」，区分一字板、炸板反复和从未触板。
pitfalls: limitPct 必须匹配板块：主板 / ST 10、创业板 / 科创板 20、北交所 30；设错会导致全程为 0
需要上一个完整交易日取昨收：序列的第一个交易日为空（2026-09-23 前用窗口首根 open 近似昨收，高开票恒为 0，已修）
从未触板的股票恒为 0，不能区分「弱势」与「还没启动」——需 Layer 1 先筛涨停池

en.summary: How firmly a limit-up board holds, separating one-price boards, repeated breaks and never-touched.
pitfalls: limitPct must match the board: main board / ST 10, ChiNext / STAR 20, Beijing 30; a wrong value keeps it at 0 throughout.

Needs a previous complete trading day for the previous close: the first trading day in the series is empty (before 2026-09-23 the window's first open approximated the previous close and gap-up stocks were always 0; fixed).
Stocks that never touched the limit are always 0, so 'weak' and 'not started yet' look the same; screen a limit-up pool first.

params.limitPct: Main board / ST 10, ChiNext / STAR 20, Beijing 30.

types.summary: 当前这一帧是否封住（1＝封住，0＝没封）。
pitfalls: 只有进了盘口采集集的标的才有值，其余恒 NaN（比较兜底 false，不会误触发）
★ 求值频率目前仍是 bar 收盘（1/分钟），适合做「现在是什么状态」的确认，不适合捕捉「刚刚发生了什么」跃迁
回测/历史区间没有盘口上下文，恒 NaN——不要拿回测结果当验证

en.summary: Whether the current frame is sealed at the limit (1 = sealed, 0 = not).
pitfalls: Only symbols in the order-book capture set have values; others are always NaN (comparisons fall back to false and never fire).
★ Evaluation still happens at bar close (once a minute): good for confirming the current state, not for catching a transition that just happened.
Backtests and historical ranges have no order-book context and are always NaN — do not treat backtest results as validation.

慢线

types.summary: 趋势明确时跟得紧、震荡时变钝的自适应均线。
pitfalls: 参数多，默认 10/2/30 即可

en.summary: Adaptive average that follows closely in clear trends and slows down in ranges.
pitfalls: Many parameters; the default 10/2/30 is fine.

params.period: Efficiency period

params.description: 最近 n 根的最高价、最低价，用来算 RSV（收盘在区间中的位置）。
K = RSV 的 m1 日平滑（SMA(RSV, m1, 1)）。
D = K 的 m2 日平滑（SMA(K, m2, 1)）。

types.summary: KDJ 的 D 线：K 的再平滑，比 K 慢，用来和 K 比交叉。
pitfalls: 单边趋势里 K、D 会长时间钝化在 80 以上或 20 以下，超买超卖信号失效
震荡市金叉死叉很多，建议配合趋势过滤（如价格在 MA20 上方才做金叉）
一字板 / 停牌补的平价 K 线最高 = 最低，RSV 无定义，这一根 K 沿用上一根

en.summary: KDJ D line: K smoothed again, slower than K, used for K/D crossovers.
pitfalls: In one-way trends K and D can stay above 80 or below 20 for long, and overbought/oversold signals fail.
Ranges produce many crossovers; add a trend filter (e.g. only take golden crosses above MA20).
On one-price limit bars or flat bars filled during halts, high = low and RSV is undefined; K carries over from the previous bar.

params.n: Highest high and lowest low of the last n bars, used to compute RSV (where the close sits in the range).
params.m1: K = RSV smoothed over m1 days (SMA(RSV, m1, 1)).
params.m2: D = K smoothed over m2 days (SMA(K, m2, 1)).

types.summary: KDJ 的 J 线 = 3K − 2D，最灵敏，可以超出 0~100。

震荡市金叉死叉很多，建议配合趋势过滤（如价格在 MA20 上方才做金叉）
一字板 / 停牌补的平价 K 线最高 = 最低，RSV 无定义，这一根 K 沿用上一根

pitfalls: In one-way trends K and D can stay above 80 or below 20 for long, and overbought/oversold signals fail.
Ranges produce many crossovers; add a trend filter (e.g. only take golden crosses above MA20).
On one-price limit bars or flat bars filled during halts, high = low and RSV is undefined; K carries over from the previous bar.

types.summary: KDJ 的 K 线：收盘价在近期高低区间中的位置（平滑后）。
pitfalls: 单边趋势里 K、D 会长时间钝化在 80 以上或 20 以下，超买超卖信号失效
震荡市金叉死叉很多，建议配合趋势过滤（如价格在 MA20 上方才做金叉）
一字板 / 停牌补的平价 K 线最高 = 最低，RSV 无定义，这一根 K 沿用上一根

pitfalls: In one-way trends K and D can stay above 80 or below 20 for long, and overbought/oversold signals fail.
Ranges produce many crossovers; add a trend filter (e.g. only take golden crosses above MA20).
On one-price limit bars or flat bars filled during halts, high = low and RSV is undefined; K carries over from the previous bar.

params.m1: K = RSV smoothed over m1 days (SMA(RSV, m1, 1)).
params.m2: D = K smoothed over m2 days (SMA(K, m2, 1)).

params.description: 中轨 EMA 的周期（根数）。
计算 ATR 的周期（根数）。
通道宽度为 ATR×倍数，数值越大通道越宽。

types.summary: 基于ATR的通道下轨，识别超卖和支撑。
pitfalls: 单边下跌趋势中，价格会贴着下轨一路向下，抄底会被套
参数敏感：ATR倍数太小会频繁触发假信号，太大则失去参考意义
横盘震荡时，下轨可能被反复穿越，产生无效信号

en.summary: ATR-based lower channel band, for oversold conditions and support.
pitfalls: In a one-way decline price rides the lower band down; bottom-fishing gets trapped.
Parameter-sensitive: a small ATR multiplier triggers false signals often, a large one makes the band meaningless.
In ranges the lower band may be crossed repeatedly with no useful signal.

params.multiplier: Channel width is ATR × multiplier; larger values widen the channel.

params.description: 中轨 EMA 的周期（根数）。

types.summary: 基于EMA的通道中轨，配合上下轨判断趋势和波动。
pitfalls: 中轨本身是滞后指标，EMA周期越大滞后越明显，刚拐头时趋势可能已走完
在横盘震荡市中，中轨会被反复穿越，产生大量假信号
单独用中轨意义不大，必须结合上下轨或成交量使用

en.summary: EMA-based middle line of the channel; read with the outer bands for trend and volatility.
pitfalls: The middle band lags, more so with longer EMA periods; when it turns, the trend may be over.
In sideways markets it is crossed repeatedly and gives many false signals.
The middle band alone means little; use it with the outer bands or volume.

params.description: 中轨 EMA 的周期（根数）。
计算 ATR 的周期（根数）。
通道宽度为 ATR×倍数，数值越大通道越宽。

types.summary: 基于EMA和ATR的波动通道上轨，用于识别超买和突破。
pitfalls: 在单边暴涨行情中，价格会一直贴着上轨走，过早卖出容易踏空
ATR参数太小或倍数太大时，上轨离价格太远，失去参考意义

en.summary: Upper band of an EMA/ATR volatility channel, for overbought conditions and breakouts.
pitfalls: In a runaway rally price rides the upper band; selling early misses the move.
With a small ATR period or a large multiplier the band is too far from price to be useful.

params.multiplier: Channel width is ATR × multiplier; larger values widen the channel.

params.description: 取 source 指标 N 根 K 线之前的值。N=1 即取上一根 K 线的值。

types.summary: 取任意指标 N 根 K 线之前的值，是构造量价背离、MACD 背离等复合判断的基础工具。
pitfalls: LAG 本身不产生信号，必须与比较运算（GT/LT）和其他指标结合才有意义
N 值越大，等待确认时间越长，信号滞后越严重
在 K 线数不足（< N + 指标预热期）时返回 NaN，系统自动视为条件不满足

en.summary: Value of any indicator N bars ago; the building block for price-volume or MACD divergences and other composite tests.
pitfalls: LAG produces no signal itself; it is meaningful only with comparisons (GT/LT) and other indicators.
Larger N means longer confirmation and more delay.
Returns NaN when there are not enough bars (< N + the indicator's warm-up); the condition is then treated as false.

params.period: Value of the source indicator N bars ago; N = 1 is the previous bar.

types.summary: 一根 bar 内 大单成交额/全部成交额。需逐笔成交。注意不是日频因子 SUPER_LARGE_RATIO。
pitfalls: 只有进了逐笔订阅集（≤50 只）的标的才有值，其余恒 NaN
大单金额线是全局固定值，对不同市值的股票严苛程度并不一致
阈值尚未标定，示例数字仅供说明

en.summary: Large-order traded value / total traded value within one bar. Needs tick-by-tick trades. Not the daily factor SUPER_LARGE_RATIO.
pitfalls: Only symbols in the tick-by-tick subscription set (≤ 50) have values; others are always NaN.
The large-order amount threshold is a global constant, so it is stricter for some market caps than others.
Thresholds are not calibrated yet; example numbers are illustrative only.

params.description: 不填＝按标的规则（主板 / ST 10、创业板 / 科创板 20、北交所 30）；填了就按它算、不看标的。标的认不出（序列名里没有代码）又没填时为空。

types.summary: 昨收 × (1 − 涨跌幅)，按最小价位取整。
pitfalls: 需要上一个完整交易日才有值：序列的第一个交易日（暖机截断、多半不完整）一律为空。

en.summary: Previous close × (1 − limit), rounded to the tick size.
pitfalls: Needs a previous complete trading day: the first trading day in the series (cut by warm-up, usually incomplete) is always empty.

params.limitPct: Empty = use the symbol's rule (main board / ST 10, ChiNext / STAR 20, Beijing 30); if set, it is used regardless of symbol. Empty when the symbol is unrecognised (no code in the series name) and nothing is set.

params.description: 按上海时区 trade_date 对齐的日线回看窗口；数据以 md_bars_1d 为主，近期缺口可由 1m 按 trade_date 回填。
要匹配的连续涨停根数，例如 3 表示 3 连板。
AT_LEAST：至少 N 连板，3 连板包含 4/5 连板；EXACT：恰好 N 连板。
ALLOW_BREAK_AFTER_STREAK：窗口内出现过即可，后面允许断板；REQUIRE_STREAK_TO_WINDOW_END：窗口末日仍处于连板。
涨停幅度默认按标的板块自动判断（主板 10、创业板/科创板 20、北交所 30，涨停价 = 前收 ×(1+幅度) 四舍五入到分），池子里主板与创业板混着也不用改。只有「认不出标的」时才用这个值兜底——回测 / 出线 / 画布预览都已自动带上标的，正常不用填。

types.summary: 判定一段时间内是否出现过连板（连续涨停），识别强势股和连板妖股。
pitfalls: 涨停板次日高开低走是常见坑，只看连板容易追高被套
一字板买不进，等开板时往往已经是高位，接盘风险极大
市场情绪退潮期，连板股可能补跌更狠，别盲目迷信

en.summary: Whether a run of consecutive limit-up days occurred in a period: identifies strong stocks and limit-up streak leaders.
pitfalls: Opening high and fading the day after a limit-up is a common trap; chasing on streaks alone gets trapped.
One-price limit boards cannot be bought; by the time the board opens price is usually high and the risk of being the bag holder is large.
When market sentiment ebbs, streak stocks can fall harder than others; do not trust streaks blindly.

params.lookbackDays: Daily lookback window aligned to trade_date in Shanghai time; data comes mainly from md_bars_1d, with recent gaps backfilled from 1m bars by trade_date.
params.limitDays: Number of consecutive limit-up bars to match, e.g. 3 means a 3-day streak.
params.matchMode: AT_LEAST: at least N in a row, so a 3-day match includes 4- and 5-day streaks; EXACT: exactly N.
params.breakPolicy: ALLOW_BREAK_AFTER_STREAK: occurring anywhere in the window is enough, breaks afterwards allowed; REQUIRE_STREAK_TO_WINDOW_END: still on a streak on the window's last day.
params.limitPct: The limit size is detected from the symbol's board by default (main board 10, ChiNext/STAR 20, Beijing 30; limit price = previous close × (1 + limit) rounded to the cent), so mixed pools need no change. This value is only a fallback when the symbol cannot be recognised — backtests, signals and canvas previews already pass the symbol, so normally leave it empty.

params.description: 不填＝按标的规则（主板 / ST 10、创业板 / 科创板 20、北交所 30）；填了就按它算、不看标的。标的认不出（序列名里没有代码）又没填时为空。

types.summary: 昨收 × (1 + 涨跌幅)，按最小价位取整。
pitfalls: 标的从序列名认，认不出（如部分预览/试跑场景）又没填 limitPct 时为空。
复权回测（默认前复权）里最近一次除权之前的日子，昨收是缩放过的，取整后可能与真实涨停价差 1 个最小价位。
需要上一个完整交易日才有值：序列的第一个交易日（暖机截断、多半不完整）一律为空。

en.summary: Previous close × (1 + limit), rounded to the tick size.
pitfalls: The symbol is recognised from the series name; empty when it cannot be (e.g. some preview or dry-run cases) and limitPct is not set.
In adjusted backtests (forward-adjusted by default), days before the latest ex-rights date have a scaled previous close; after rounding it may differ from the real limit price by one tick.
Needs a previous complete trading day: the first trading day in the series (cut by warm-up, usually incomplete) is always empty.

params.limitPct: Empty = use the symbol's rule (main board / ST 10, ChiNext / STAR 20, Beijing 30); if set, it is used regardless of symbol. Empty when the symbol is unrecognised (no code in the series name) and nothing is set.

params.description: 线性回归拟合优度，范围 0-1，越接近 1 趋势越线性。

types.summary: 衡量线性趋势的「靠谱程度」，值越高趋势越稳。
pitfalls: R2 只衡量线性关系，对「急涨急跌」的抛物线型趋势会给出低值，容易错过主升浪
参数周期选得太短（如 5 天），R2 容易忽高忽低，产生大量假信号
R2 本身不指示方向，单独用会陷入「趋势很好但方向错了」的尴尬

en.summary: How reliable a linear trend is; higher means steadier.
pitfalls: R² measures only linear fit; parabolic surges score low, so it can miss the main leg of a rally.
A short period (e.g. 5 days) makes R² jumpy and full of false signals.
R² has no direction; alone it can say 'great trend' while the trend is down.

params.period: Goodness of fit of a linear regression, 0–1; closer to 1 means more linear.

params.description: 输入序列在窗口内的最小二乘斜率，按均价归一为每根 K 线百分比。

types.summary: 用线性回归衡量价格趋势的强度和方向，比均线更灵敏。
pitfalls: 在震荡行情中斜率会频繁正负切换，产生大量假信号，比均线更容易被「左右打脸」
斜率对价格突变非常敏感，一根大阳线或大阴线会瞬间改变斜率，容易误导你追涨杀跌
不同周期参数下斜率数值差异很大，不能跨周期直接比较，必须固定参数看相对变化

en.summary: Strength and direction of the price trend via linear regression; more responsive than a moving average.
pitfalls: In ranges the slope flips sign often and whipsaws more than a moving average.
The slope is very sensitive to sudden moves; one big bar changes it at once and invites chasing.
Slope values differ greatly across periods; do not compare across periods, watch relative change with fixed parameters.

params.period: Least-squares slope of the input series over the window, normalised by the mean price to percent per bar.

params.description: 计算量比时使用的历史均量回望根数。5=短线，20=波段。

types.summary: 量化「低位放量承接」的强度：量比 × 下影线/实体，捕捉多方在低位强力护盘的信号。
pitfalls: 连续涨停/跌停板时，下影线可能极小甚至为零，承接力数值会失真
大盘股和小盘股的承接力数值不可直接比较——流通盘大小影响量比基数
只看承接力不看价格位置容易误判：高位放量长下影可能是出货而非承接

en.summary: Quantifies buying support at lows: volume ratio × lower shadow / body; captures buyers defending the price.
pitfalls: During consecutive limit-up/limit-down boards the lower shadow is tiny or zero and the value is distorted.
Values are not comparable between large and small caps — free float affects the volume-ratio base.
Ignoring price location misleads: a long lower shadow on high volume at a high can be distribution, not support.

params.period: Lookback (bars) of average volume for the volume ratio. 5 = short-term, 20 = swing.

params.description: 回看根数。

types.summary: 输入序列（缺省收盘价）在最近 N 根里的最小值。
pitfalls: 含当根

en.summary: Minimum of the input series (close by default) over the last N bars.
pitfalls: Includes the current bar.

params.period: Lookback (bars).

params.description: 快线 EMA 周期；若与 slow 均省略则使用 Ta4j 默认 MACD。
慢线 EMA 周期；须大于快线（运行时会自动保证 slow≥fast+1）。

types.summary: 快慢两条 EMA 的差值，量化趋势动能与转折。
pitfalls: 横盘市场会频繁金叉死叉，假信号成倍增加
MACD 本质是滞后指标，趋势确认时往往已经走了一半
0 轴附近的金叉死叉效果差，建议结合 0 轴位置过滤

en.summary: Difference between a fast and a slow EMA; quantifies trend momentum and turns.
pitfalls: In sideways markets crossovers multiply and false signals double.
MACD lags; when a trend is confirmed it is often half over.
Crossovers near the zero line work poorly; filter by position relative to zero.

params.fast: Fast EMA period; if both this and slow are omitted the Ta4j default MACD is used.
params.slow: Slow EMA period; must exceed the fast one (the runtime enforces slow ≥ fast + 1).

params.description: MACD 快线周期。
MACD 慢线周期（须大于快线）。
用于计算柱（MACD−信号线）的周期。

types.summary: MACD 柱 = 快慢线差值再平滑，反映动能强弱和背离。
pitfalls: 在震荡市里，柱子频繁翻红翻绿，信号密集且虚假，追涨杀跌会被反复打脸
背离信号在单边强趋势中可能连续出现多次「假背离」，价格继续原方向运行
柱子缩短不等于马上反转，只是动能减弱，可能横盘后再加速，过早反向操作会踏空

en.summary: MACD histogram = the difference of the fast and slow lines, smoothed again; shows momentum strength and divergence.
pitfalls: In ranges the histogram flips sign often with dense, false signals; chasing gets whipsawed.
In strong one-way trends divergences can appear several times and fail while price keeps going.
A shrinking histogram is not an immediate reversal, only fading momentum; price may pause and accelerate again, so fading it early misses the move.

params.slow: MACD slow period (must exceed the fast period).
params.signal: Period used for the histogram (MACD − signal line).

params.description: MACD 快线周期。
MACD 慢线周期（须大于快线）。
对 MACD 线再取 EMA 的周期（信号线）。

types.summary: MACD 的慢线，用于确认趋势和发出买卖信号。
pitfalls: 震荡市中金叉死叉频繁出现，胜率极低，容易反复被割
信号线滞后于快线，等金叉出现时行情可能已经走了一大半
单独看信号线容易误判，必须结合快线位置和零轴判断趋势强弱

en.summary: MACD's slow line, used to confirm trends and generate signals.
pitfalls: In ranges crossovers are frequent with a very low hit rate.
The signal line lags the MACD line; by the golden cross much of the move may be gone.
Reading the signal line alone misleads; use the MACD line's position and the zero line to judge trend strength.

params.slow: MACD slow period (must exceed the fast period).
params.signal: EMA period applied to the MACD line (signal line).

types.summary: 两个序列逐根取较大者。
pitfalls: 是两个序列逐根比较，不是 N 根内最高——那是 HIGHEST。
任一侧为空（NaN）结果即为空，比较条件不成立。
在主周期上逐根运算；自身写 timeframe 不生效，要高周期的量就把 timeframe 写在操作数指标上。

en.summary: Bar-by-bar larger of two series.
pitfalls: Compares two series bar by bar; it is not the highest over N bars — that is HIGHEST.
If either side is empty (NaN) the result is empty and the comparison is false.
Computed bar by bar on the primary timeframe; a timeframe on this node has no effect. For a higher-timeframe quantity, put timeframe on the operand indicator.

params.description: 先计算输入序列的 SMA。
当前均线相对 N 根前均线的百分比变化。

types.summary: 衡量均线倾斜程度，判断趋势强弱与转折。
pitfalls: 斜率本身波动大，容易频繁发出假信号，尤其在横盘震荡时上下乱窜
参数周期选太短（如 5 日均线+3 根斜率间隔）噪音极大，几乎没法用
斜率只反映均线的变化速度，不反映价格位置，高位斜率回落可能是正常调整而非反转

en.summary: How steeply a moving average is tilted: trend strength and turns.
pitfalls: The slope itself is volatile and gives frequent false signals, especially in ranges.
Very short settings (e.g. a 5-day MA with a 3-bar slope lag) are too noisy to use.
The slope reflects how fast the average changes, not where price is; a falling slope at a high may be a normal correction, not a reversal.

params.period: First computes an SMA of the input series.
params.slopeBars: Percent change of the current average versus the average N bars ago.

types.summary: （最高 + 最低）÷ 2，AO 等指标的输入。

en.summary: (high + low) ÷ 2; the input to AO and similar indicators.

params.description: MFI 典型周期 14。用于该指标计算所回溯的 K 线根数（周期越大曲线越平滑、滞后越大）。

types.summary: 结合价格与成交量的超买超卖指标，类似成交量加权的 RSI。
pitfalls: 在持续单边牛市中，MFI 可能长期在 80 以上钝化，过早卖出会踏空
MFI 对成交量异常敏感，如果股票突然放量（比如庄家对倒），MFI 会失真
背离信号在震荡市里准确率较高，但在强趋势中可能反复出现假背离

en.summary: Overbought/oversold indicator combining price and volume, like a volume-weighted RSI.
pitfalls: In a sustained bull run MFI can stay above 80 for long; selling early misses the move.
MFI is very sensitive to volume; sudden volume (e.g. wash trades) distorts it.
Divergences work better in ranges; in strong trends they can fail repeatedly.

params.period: Typical MFI period is 14: number of bars looked back (larger is smoother and lags more).

types.summary: 两个序列逐根取较小者。
pitfalls: 是两个序列逐根比较，不是 N 根内最低——那是 LOWEST。
任一侧为空（NaN）结果即为空，比较条件不成立。
在主周期上逐根运算；自身写 timeframe 不生效，要高周期的量就把 timeframe 写在操作数指标上。

en.summary: Bar-by-bar smaller of two series.
pitfalls: Compares two series bar by bar; it is not the lowest over N bars — that is LOWEST.
If either side is empty (NaN) the result is empty and the comparison is false.
Computed bar by bar on the primary timeframe; a timeframe on this node has no effect. For a higher-timeframe quantity, put timeframe on the operand indicator.

params.description: −DI 计算周期。

types.summary: 衡量下跌动能的强度，与+DI配合判断趋势方向。
pitfalls: 在震荡市中-DI和+DI频繁交叉，会产生大量假信号，容易追涨杀跌
单独看-DI没有意义，必须和+DI、ADX一起用，否则容易误判趋势
参数周期太短（如5以下）会导致-DI过于敏感，噪声多；太长（如30以上）则反应迟钝，错过行情

en.summary: Strength of downward movement; read with +DI for trend direction.
pitfalls: In ranges −DI and +DI cross often and produce many false signals.
−DI alone means nothing; use it with +DI and ADX.
A period under about 5 is over-sensitive and noisy; over about 30 reacts too slowly.

params.period: −DI period.

types.summary: 最近一次触及今日最高价到现在过了几分钟。
pitfalls: 需要上一个完整交易日才有值：序列的第一个交易日（暖机截断、多半不完整）一律为空，暖机按 3 个交易日折算。
价格与主序列同一复权口径；百分比一律以昨收为分母。

en.summary: Minutes since price last touched today's high.
pitfalls: Needs a previous complete trading day: the first trading day in the series (cut by warm-up, usually incomplete) is always empty; warm-up counts as 3 trading days.
Prices use the same adjustment as the primary series; percentages always use the previous close as denominator.

types.summary: 最近一次触及今日最低价到现在过了几分钟。
pitfalls: 需要上一个完整交易日才有值：序列的第一个交易日（暖机截断、多半不完整）一律为空，暖机按 3 个交易日折算。
价格与主序列同一复权口径；百分比一律以昨收为分母。

en.summary: Minutes since price last touched today's low.
pitfalls: Needs a previous complete trading day: the first trading day in the series (cut by warm-up, usually incomplete) is always empty; warm-up counts as 3 trading days.
Prices use the same adjustment as the primary series; percentages always use the previous close as denominator.

types.summary: 开盘后第几分钟（交易时间，午休连续计时）。
pitfalls: 分钟级阈值要求 1m 主周期；5m 主周期上只能取到 5 的倍数（0、5、10…）。
需要上一个完整交易日才有值：序列的第一个交易日（暖机截断、多半不完整）一律为空，暖机按 3 个交易日折算。
价格与主序列同一复权口径；百分比一律以昨收为分母。

en.summary: Minute of the session since the open (trading time; the lunch break is skipped).
pitfalls: Minute-level thresholds need a 1m primary timeframe; a 5m primary timeframe only yields multiples of 5 (0, 5, 10 ...).
Needs a previous complete trading day: the first trading day in the series (cut by warm-up, usually incomplete) is always empty; warm-up counts as 3 trading days.
Prices use the same adjustment as the primary series; percentages always use the previous close as denominator.

params.description: 基准取序列里此前多少个完整交易日（停牌日自然跳过）；凑不齐为空。暖机按 N + 2 个交易日折算。

types.summary: 当根量 ÷ 过去 N 日同一根（同一「开盘后分钟」）的均量。
pitfalls: 需要上一个完整交易日才有值：序列的第一个交易日（暖机截断、多半不完整）一律为空。

en.summary: Current bar's volume ÷ average volume of the same bar (same minute since the open) over the past N days.
pitfalls: Needs a previous complete trading day: the first trading day in the series (cut by warm-up, usually incomplete) is always empty.

params.days: Baseline uses this many previous complete trading days in the series (halted days are skipped); empty if not enough. Warm-up counts as N + 2 trading days.

params.description: 周期

types.summary: 当前收盘与 N 根前收盘之差，衡量涨跌速度。
pitfalls: 是价差，不同价位的股票不能直接比

en.summary: Current close minus the close N bars ago: speed of the move.
pitfalls: It is a price difference; not comparable across price levels.

params.period: Period

types.summary: 两个操作数逐根相乘。
pitfalls: 任一侧为空（NaN）结果即为空，比较条件不成立。
在主周期上逐根运算；自身写 timeframe 不生效，要高周期的量就把 timeframe 写在操作数指标上。

en.summary: Multiplies two operands bar by bar.
pitfalls: If either side is empty (NaN) the result is empty and the comparison is false.
Computed bar by bar on the primary timeframe; a timeframe on this node has no effect. For a higher-timeframe quantity, put timeframe on the operand indicator.

params.description: 底层 VWAP 窗口。
对 VWAP 再平滑的周期。

types.summary: 带成交量的移动平均，量价结合判断趋势强度。
pitfalls: 成交量异常放大（如突然暴雷或利好）时 MVWAP 会剧烈跳动，容易给出假信号
横盘震荡期 MVWAP 和价格反复缠绕，频繁买卖会亏手续费
不同股票的成交量基数不同，MVWAP 的数值绝对值没有可比性，只能看相对位置

en.summary: Moving average of VWAP: combines price and volume to judge trend strength.
pitfalls: Abnormal volume (sudden bad or good news) makes MVWAP jump and gives false signals.
In ranges MVWAP and price intertwine; frequent trading loses to fees.
Volume bases differ by stock, so absolute MVWAP values are not comparable; only relative position matters.

types.summary: 通过量价关系判断资金流向，辅助验证趋势。
pitfalls: OBV 在极端行情（如连续涨停/跌停）时会失真，因为成交量可能被限制或情绪化放大
OBV 本身不给出买卖点，必须结合价格形态或均线使用，单独看容易误判
大盘股和庄股的 OBV 表现差异很大：庄股 OBV 可能被操纵，而大盘股更真实

en.summary: Judges money flow from price-volume behaviour; helps confirm trends.
pitfalls: OBV is distorted in extreme moves (consecutive limit-up/down) because volume is capped or emotionally inflated.
OBV gives no entry or exit itself; combine it with price patterns or moving averages.
OBV behaves very differently for large caps and heavily controlled stocks: the latter's OBV can be manipulated.

labels.zh: 主动买卖不平衡 OFI · L2

types.summary: 一根 bar 内 (主动买额-主动卖额)/(主动买额+主动卖额)，取值 [-1, 1]。需逐笔成交。
pitfalls: 只有进了逐笔订阅集（≤50 只）的标的才有值，其余恒 NaN
深市方向是**推断**不是事实，样本少时噪声大
回测/历史区间在逐笔回放接上前恒 NaN，不要拿回测结果当验证

en.summary: (aggressive buy value − aggressive sell value) / (aggressive buy value + aggressive sell value) within one bar, in [−1, 1]. Needs tick-by-tick trades.
pitfalls: Only symbols in the tick-by-tick subscription set (≤ 50) have values; others are always NaN.
For Shenzhen the trade direction is **inferred**, not reported; noisy with few samples.
Backtests and historical ranges are always NaN until tick-by-tick replay is connected; do not treat backtest results as validation.

types.summary: 通过反转点跟踪趋势，自动提示止损或转向。
pitfalls: 横盘震荡时会被反复打脸，SAR 点频繁上下翻转，导致连续亏损
加速因子固定，遇到急涨急跌行情可能跟不上，止损被打掉后行情继续
在跳空缺口或极端行情下，SAR 点可能瞬间远离价格，失去参考意义

en.summary: Follows a trend through reversal points and suggests stops or reversals.
pitfalls: In ranges the SAR flips back and forth, causing a string of losses.
The acceleration factor is fixed; in sharp moves it may lag, stopping you out before the move continues.
With gaps or extreme moves the SAR can jump far from price and lose meaning.

params.description: 形态最短跨度：第一个贴线点到突破至少多少根。默认 20。
贴线的摆动点都在最近多少根以内。默认 80。
三角形收敛比例。
向上突破确认幅度。默认日线 1.5%（填小数 0.015），留空＝按周期自动：以日线为基准，按时间平方根换算（小时线约 1/2、15 分钟约 1/4、5 分钟约 1/7、周线约 2.2 倍）；填了就按填的值。
选择用户语义里哪种突破成立；成立统一返回 +1。
每条边至少几个摆动点贴线（两点只能连一条线，第三个点才验证它）。默认 3。
画线容差：摆动点离线这么近算贴线；从第一个点到突破前，任何 K 线越过边线超过这个比例，这条线作废。默认 1.5%（0.015）。
整段形态里边线的漂移不超过起始高度的这个比例就算「平」：两边都平＝矩形，上平下升＝上升三角，上降下平＝下降三角，上降下升＝对称三角。默认 0.2。
BREAKOUT＝突破当根；RETEST＝突破后回踩确认（例：昨天跳空突破、今天回踩）。
回踩模式：突破发生在此前多少根以内；中间不能已经踩过或收回线内。
回踩模式：最低价（向下破位时最高价）回到边线这么近算踩到。默认日线 2%（0.02），留空＝按周期自动：以日线为基准，按时间平方根换算（小时线约 1/2、15 分钟约 1/4、5 分钟约 1/7、周线约 2.2 倍）；填了就按填的值。
连续多少根闭合 K 线有效突破才返回信号。
CLOSE 使用收盘确认；HIGH_LOW 使用最高/最低价触发。
ATR 突破过滤使用的历史周期。
设为 0 关闭；大于 0 时突破幅度需同时满足 ATR 倍数过滤。
触点优先按局部 swing high/low 统计，跨度越大越严格；无拐点时回退到普通贴线计数。
1＝确认那根的前一根还没突破才算（突破后不再每天重复报）；0＝站在线外就一直报（旧行为）。
向上突破那根的量 ≥ 前 N 根均量 × 此值才算；0＝不看量。向下破位不要求放量。
放量倍数与前多少根的均量比。
三角形起始宽度占价格的百分比下限；太窄的「三角形」只是窄幅波动。默认日线 6%，留空＝按周期自动：以日线为基准，按时间平方根换算（小时线约 1/2、15 分钟约 1/4、5 分钟约 1/7、周线约 2.2 倍）；填了就按填的值。
幅度上限（%），留空＝不限。与「形态最小幅度」一起圈定范围，例如只要震荡幅度 5%～20% 的箱体。

types.summary: 上升三角形是看涨的持续整理形态，预示突破上涨。
pitfalls: 2026-09-23 起默认口径收紧：只认新突破、突破幅度 ≥1.5%、向上突破要放量、形态要有足够幅度。旧口径下 W 底 / M 头约 25% 的股票日都报信号，基本是噪音；收紧后罕见，但实测事件后 10 日胜率仍在 45%–55%，形态本身预测力有限，建议与趋势 / 量能条件组合使用。
横盘震荡或下跌趋势中出现的类似形态很可能是假突破，容易追高被套
突破后如果成交量没有放大，可能是假突破，需要等待确认

en.summary: A bullish continuation pattern that anticipates an upside breakout.
pitfalls: Since 2026-09-23 the default is stricter: only fresh breakouts, a breakout of at least 1.5%, volume on upside breaks, and a pattern of sufficient size. Under the old defaults double bottoms/tops fired on about 25% of stock-days, mostly noise; now they are rare, but the 10-day hit rate after events is still 45%–55%. The pattern alone has limited predictive power; combine it with trend or volume conditions.
Similar shapes in ranges or downtrends are likely false breakouts; chasing gets trapped.
A breakout without expanding volume may be false; wait for confirmation.

params.minLookback: Minimum pattern span: bars from the first touch point to the breakout. Default 20.
params.maxLookback: All touching swing points must lie within this many recent bars. Default 80.
params.breakPct: Upside breakout confirmation size. Default 1.5% on daily (enter 0.015). Empty = scale automatically by timeframe from the daily value by the square root of time (hourly ≈ 1/2, 15m ≈ 1/4, 5m ≈ 1/7, weekly ≈ 2.2×); if set, the given value is used.
params.breakoutSide: Which breakout in the user's terms counts; a match always returns +1.
params.touchMin: Minimum swing points touching each side (two points only define a line; the third verifies it). Default 3.
params.lineTolerancePct: Line tolerance: swing points this close to the line count as touching; if any bar from the first point to before the breakout crosses the line by more than this ratio, the line is discarded. Default 1.5% (0.015).
params.flatDriftRatio: A side is 'flat' if it drifts less than this share of the starting height over the pattern: both flat = rectangle, flat top and rising bottom = ascending triangle, falling top and flat bottom = descending triangle, falling top and rising bottom = symmetric triangle. Default 0.2.
params.trigger: BREAKOUT = the breakout bar; RETEST = a retest after the breakout (e.g. gapped through yesterday, retested today).
