en.summary: Lowest price of the previous N bars (excluding the current one) when their range is ≤ maxRangePct%.
pitfalls: Outputs a price (same adjustment as the primary series); empty when it cannot be computed, and comparisons are false.
Use with rule nodes TOUCH / BREAK / RECLAIM / RETEST: {"type":"BREAK","level":{"ind":"name"}}.

params.bars: Lookback bars, excluding the current bar.

params.description: +DI 计算周期。

types.summary: 衡量上涨方向动量的指标，常与-DI配合判断趋势。
pitfalls: 在震荡行情中，+DI 和 -DI 会频繁交叉，产生大量假信号，容易追涨杀跌
+DI 本身不给出具体买卖点，必须结合 -DI 和 ADX 一起用，单独看容易误判
参数周期太短（如 7）会导致指标过于敏感，噪声多；周期太长（如 30）则反应迟钝，错过行情

en.summary: Strength of upward movement; usually read with −DI for trend.
pitfalls: In ranges +DI and −DI cross often and produce many false signals.
+DI gives no entry or exit itself; use it with −DI and ADX.
A short period (e.g. 7) is over-sensitive and noisy; a long one (e.g. 30) reacts too slowly.

params.period: +DI period.

types.summary: 上一交易日最后一根 K 线的收盘价。
pitfalls: 需要上一个完整交易日才有值：序列的第一个交易日（暖机截断、多半不完整）一律为空，暖机按 3 个交易日折算。
价格与主序列同一复权口径；百分比一律以昨收为分母。

en.summary: Close of the last bar of the previous trading day.
pitfalls: Needs a previous complete trading day: the first trading day in the series (cut by warm-up, usually incomplete) is always empty; warm-up counts as 3 trading days.
Prices use the same adjustment as the primary series; percentages always use the previous close as denominator.

types.summary: 上一交易日最高价。
pitfalls: 需要上一个完整交易日才有值：序列的第一个交易日（暖机截断、多半不完整）一律为空，暖机按 3 个交易日折算。
价格与主序列同一复权口径；百分比一律以昨收为分母。

en.summary: High of the previous trading day.
pitfalls: Needs a previous complete trading day: the first trading day in the series (cut by warm-up, usually incomplete) is always empty; warm-up counts as 3 trading days.
Prices use the same adjustment as the primary series; percentages always use the previous close as denominator.

types.summary: 上一交易日最低价。
pitfalls: 需要上一个完整交易日才有值：序列的第一个交易日（暖机截断、多半不完整）一律为空，暖机按 3 个交易日折算。
价格与主序列同一复权口径；百分比一律以昨收为分母。

en.summary: Low of the previous trading day.
pitfalls: Needs a previous complete trading day: the first trading day in the series (cut by warm-up, usually incomplete) is always empty; warm-up counts as 3 trading days.
Prices use the same adjustment as the primary series; percentages always use the previous close as denominator.

params.description: 价格序列字段。CLOSE 为默认收盘价，也可取 OPEN/HIGH/LOW。

types.summary: 直接使用K线的开盘、收盘、最高、最低价作为指标。
pitfalls: 单独看收盘价容易忽略盘中波动，尤其日内交易者需要结合高低价
不同股票的价格绝对值差异大，不能直接比较价格高低

en.summary: Uses the bar's open, close, high or low directly as an indicator.
pitfalls: The close alone ignores intraday swings; intraday traders should consider highs and lows too.
Absolute prices differ widely across stocks and are not comparable.

params.field: Price field. CLOSE by default; OPEN/HIGH/LOW also available.

params.description: 用于计算突破基准的历史高点窗口，不包含确认 K 线。
连续多少根闭合 K 线有效上破才返回 +1。
CLOSE 使用收盘确认；HIGH_LOW 使用最高价触发。
相对前高的最小突破比例；0.002 表示至少上破 0.2%。
ATR 突破过滤使用的历史周期。
设为 0 关闭；大于 0 时突破距离需达到 ATR 的指定倍数。

types.summary: 价格突破近期高点，经典追涨信号。
pitfalls: 横盘震荡时频繁假突破，一买就套，胜率很低
突破后如果量能不足，容易冲高回落，需要配合成交量验证
周期选太小（如 5 日）信号太多，选太大（如 60 日）信号太少，容易错过行情

en.summary: Price breaks above a recent high: the classic momentum-chasing signal.
pitfalls: In ranges false breakouts are frequent and buyers get trapped; low hit rate.
Without enough volume a breakout often fades; confirm with volume.
A small period (e.g. 5 days) fires too often, a large one (e.g. 60 days) too rarely.

params.period: Window of past highs used as the breakout reference, excluding the confirmation bars.
params.confirmBars: Number of consecutive closed bars with a valid break above before returning +1.
params.breakoutBasis: CLOSE confirms on the close; HIGH_LOW triggers on the high.
params.breakPct: Minimum break above the prior high; 0.002 means at least 0.2%.
params.atrPeriod: Lookback period for the ATR breakout filter.
params.breakAtrMultiple: 0 disables it; above 0 the breakout distance must reach this ATR multiple.

params.description: 用于计算跌破基准的历史低点窗口，不包含确认 K 线。
连续多少根闭合 K 线有效下破才返回 +1。
CLOSE 使用收盘确认；HIGH_LOW 使用最低价触发。
相对前低的最小跌破比例；0.002 表示至少下破 0.2%。
ATR 突破过滤使用的历史周期。
设为 0 关闭；大于 0 时跌破距离需达到 ATR 的指定倍数。

types.summary: 价格跌破过去N根K线的最低点，经典向下突破信号。
pitfalls: 横盘震荡时，前低频繁被突破又收回，容易反复打脸
突破后可能假突破，价格迅速拉回，需要配合确认根数或成交量过滤
周期选太大，信号太少；周期选太小，噪音太多

en.summary: Price falls below the lowest low of the past N bars: the classic downside break.
pitfalls: In ranges the prior low is broken and recovered often, causing whipsaws.
Breaks may be false and snap back; filter with confirmation bars or volume.
A large period gives too few signals, a small one too much noise.

params.period: Window of past lows used as the breakdown reference, excluding the confirmation bars.
params.confirmBars: Number of consecutive closed bars with a valid break below before returning +1.
params.breakoutBasis: CLOSE confirms on the close; HIGH_LOW triggers on the low.
params.breakPct: Minimum break below the prior low; 0.002 means at least 0.2%.
params.atrPeriod: Lookback period for the ATR breakout filter.
params.breakAtrMultiple: 0 disables it; above 0 the breakdown distance must reach this ATR multiple.

params.description: 不含当根的回看根数。

labels.zh: 前 N 根最高（不含当根）
labels.en: Highest of previous N bars (excluding current)

types.summary: 前 N 根的最高价，不含当根。「突破前高」＝ BREAK(level=PRIOR_HIGH)。
pitfalls: 要「N 日前高」就给它写 timeframe:"1d"（已收完的日线），或直接用 HIGHEST(timeframe=1d)。
输出是价格（与主序列同一复权口径）；算不出时为空，比较条件不成立。
配合规则节点 TOUCH / BREAK / RECLAIM / RETEST 使用：{"type":"BREAK","level":{"ind":"名字"}}。

en.summary: Highest price of the previous N bars, excluding the current bar. 'Break above the prior high' = BREAK(level=PRIOR_HIGH).
pitfalls: For the 'N-day prior high', give it timeframe:"1d" (completed daily bars), or use HIGHEST(timeframe=1d).
Outputs a price (same adjustment as the primary series); empty when it cannot be computed, and comparisons are false.
Use with rule nodes TOUCH / BREAK / RECLAIM / RETEST: {"type":"BREAK","level":{"ind":"name"}}.

params.bars: Lookback bars, excluding the current bar.

params.description: 不含当根的回看根数。

labels.zh: 前 N 根最低（不含当根）
labels.en: Lowest of previous N bars (excluding current)

types.summary: 前 N 根的最低价，不含当根。
pitfalls: 输出是价格（与主序列同一复权口径）；算不出时为空，比较条件不成立。
配合规则节点 TOUCH / BREAK / RECLAIM / RETEST 使用：{"type":"BREAK","level":{"ind":"名字"}}。

en.summary: Lowest price of the previous N bars, excluding the current bar.
pitfalls: Outputs a price (same adjustment as the primary series); empty when it cannot be computed, and comparisons are false.
Use with rule nodes TOUCH / BREAK / RECLAIM / RETEST: {"type":"BREAK","level":{"ind":"name"}}.

params.bars: Lookback bars, excluding the current bar.

params.description: 统计窗口（根数）。

types.summary: N 日内上涨天数占比，反映市场情绪冷热。
pitfalls: 只数涨跌天数、不看幅度，小涨多日与大涨一日同样计 1

en.summary: Share of up days within N days: how hot or cold sentiment is.
pitfalls: Counts up and down days only, ignoring size: many small gains and one big gain each count 1.

params.period: Window (bars).

params.description: 周期

types.summary: 近 N 根「收盘 − 开盘」的均值，看阳线多还是阴线多。
pitfalls: 是价差，不同价位的股票不能直接比

en.summary: Average of (close − open) over the last N bars: whether up bars or down bars dominate.
pitfalls: It is a price difference; not comparable across price levels.

params.period: Period

params.description: 向前回看多少秒。缺省 30 秒是结构性缺省，不是标定过的值。上限由行情侧秒环长度夹住。

labels.zh: 最近N秒 撤单率 · L2
labels.en: Cancellation rate, last N seconds · L2

types.summary: 最近 N 秒的撤单额 / 委托额。
pitfalls: 分母是委托额，撤单本身不进分母——否则撤得越狠比值反而越低。
标的需在 L2 行情覆盖范围内才有数据，否则该指标恒为空。

en.summary: Cancelled amount / ordered amount over the last N seconds.
pitfalls: The denominator is order amount; cancellations are not in it — otherwise heavier cancelling would lower the ratio.
The symbol must be within L2 market-data coverage, otherwise the indicator is always empty.

params.seconds: Seconds to look back. The default 30 is structural, not calibrated. Capped by the market-data second ring length.

params.description: 向前回看多少秒。缺省 30 秒是结构性缺省，不是标定过的值。上限由行情侧秒环长度夹住。

labels.zh: 最近N秒 大单占比 · L2
labels.en: Large-order share, last N seconds · L2

types.summary: 最近 N 秒的大单成交额 / 全部成交额。
pitfalls: 大单线本身没标定过，占比的绝对值意义有限，先看相对高低。
标的需在 L2 行情覆盖范围内才有数据，否则该指标恒为空。

en.summary: Large-order traded value / total traded value over the last N seconds.
pitfalls: The large-order threshold is not calibrated; the absolute share means little, compare relative levels first.
The symbol must be within L2 market-data coverage, otherwise the indicator is always empty.

params.seconds: Seconds to look back. The default 30 is structural, not calibrated. Capped by the market-data second ring length.

params.description: 向前回看多少秒。缺省 30 秒是结构性缺省，不是标定过的值。上限由行情侧秒环长度夹住。

labels.zh: 最近N秒 主力净额 · L2
labels.en: Main-force net, last N seconds · L2

types.summary: 最近 N 秒的大单主动买额 − 大单主动卖额，单位元。
pitfalls: 金额量级随股票市值差很多，跨标的比较要先归一。
标的需在 L2 行情覆盖范围内才有数据，否则该指标恒为空。

en.summary: Large-order aggressive buy value − aggressive sell value over the last N seconds, in yuan.
pitfalls: Magnitudes vary greatly with market cap; normalise before comparing across symbols.
The symbol must be within L2 market-data coverage, otherwise the indicator is always empty.

params.seconds: Seconds to look back. The default 30 is structural, not calibrated. Capped by the market-data second ring length.

params.description: 向前回看多少秒。缺省 30 秒是结构性缺省，不是标定过的值。上限由行情侧秒环长度夹住。

labels.zh: 最近N秒 主动买卖不平衡 · L2
labels.en: Order flow imbalance, last N seconds · L2

types.summary: 最近 N 秒的主动买入额与主动卖出额之差占比，取值 [-1,1]。
pitfalls: 窗口太短会被单笔大单主导，噪声很大；太长又退化成 OFI。标定时先看分布再定。
标的需在 L2 行情覆盖范围内才有数据，否则该指标恒为空。

en.summary: Aggressive buy value minus aggressive sell value as a share of their sum over the last N seconds, in [−1, 1].
pitfalls: Too short a window is dominated by single large trades and very noisy; too long degenerates into OFI. Look at the distribution before choosing.
The symbol must be within L2 market-data coverage, otherwise the indicator is always empty.

params.seconds: Seconds to look back. The default 30 is structural, not calibrated. Capped by the market-data second ring length.

params.description: ROC 计算窗口（根数）。

types.summary: 衡量价格变动速度，发现超买超卖和背离。
pitfalls: ROC 在横盘震荡时频繁穿越 0 轴，会产生大量假信号，让你反复买卖亏手续费
ROC 只看两个时间点的价格差，容易受单日异常波动影响，比如某天突然拉涨停，ROC 会瞬间飙升，但趋势未必持续
不同股票的波动率不同，统一的阈值（如 ±20）可能完全无效，需要根据历史数据调整

en.summary: Speed of price change; finds overbought/oversold conditions and divergences.
pitfalls: In ranges ROC crosses 0 often, generating many false signals and fee-draining trades.
ROC compares two points in time only and is distorted by single-day anomalies; a sudden limit-up spikes it without the trend necessarily continuing.
Volatility differs by stock; a fixed threshold (e.g. ±20) may be useless, tune it on history.

params.period: ROC window (bars).

params.description: 0＝按价格量级自动（个位价 1 元、十位价 10 元……）。

types.summary: 上一根收盘之上最近的 step 整数倍（锚在上一根，当根突破时关口不跟着跳）。step=0 按价格量级自动（9.95 → 10 元关口）。
pitfalls: 输出是价格（与主序列同一复权口径）；算不出时为空，比较条件不成立。
配合规则节点 TOUCH / BREAK / RECLAIM / RETEST 使用：{"type":"BREAK","level":{"ind":"名字"}}。

en.summary: Nearest multiple of step above the previous close (anchored on the previous bar, so it does not jump when the current bar breaks it). step = 0 picks a step from the price magnitude (9.95 → the 10-yuan level).
pitfalls: Outputs a price (same adjustment as the primary series); empty when it cannot be computed, and comparisons are false.
Use with rule nodes TOUCH / BREAK / RECLAIM / RETEST: {"type":"BREAK","level":{"ind":"name"}}.

params.step: 0 = automatic by price magnitude (1 yuan for single-digit prices, 10 for double-digit ...).

params.description: 0＝按价格量级自动。

types.summary: 上一根收盘之下最近的 step 整数倍。
pitfalls: 输出是价格（与主序列同一复权口径）；算不出时为空，比较条件不成立。
配合规则节点 TOUCH / BREAK / RECLAIM / RETEST 使用：{"type":"BREAK","level":{"ind":"名字"}}。

en.summary: Nearest multiple of step below the previous close.
pitfalls: Outputs a price (same adjustment as the primary series); empty when it cannot be computed, and comparisons are false.
Use with rule nodes TOUCH / BREAK / RECLAIM / RETEST: {"type":"BREAK","level":{"ind":"name"}}.

params.description: RSI 回溯周期；后端与 Ta4j 一致会将结果钳制为至少 2。

types.summary: 通过最近 N 期涨跌幅比衡量超买超卖，0-100 区间的震荡指标。
pitfalls: 单边趋势市场 RSI 会长期「钝化」（持续 > 80 或 < 20），不发信号或发错信号
短周期 RSI（< 7）噪声极大，假信号频繁，建议至少 9 以上
单独用 RSI 抄底，在熊市会越买越套——必须配合趋势过滤

en.summary: Oscillator (0–100) measuring overbought/oversold from the ratio of gains to losses over N periods.
pitfalls: In one-way trends RSI stays pinned (above 80 or below 20) and gives no or wrong signals.
Short-period RSI (< 7) is very noisy; use at least 9.
Bottom-fishing on RSI alone keeps buying into a bear market; add a trend filter.

params.period: RSI lookback; the backend clamps it to at least 2, consistent with Ta4j.

types.summary: 封单额（元）＝买一价×买一量。★ 仅当买一价站上涨停价时才有值，否则 NaN。
pitfalls: 封单额的绝对值对不同市值的股票不可横向比较，通常要配 SEAL_RATIO 一起用
只有进了盘口采集集的标的才有值，其余恒 NaN（比较兜底 false，不会误触发）
★ 求值频率目前仍是 bar 收盘（1/分钟），适合做「现在是什么状态」的确认，不适合捕捉「刚刚发生了什么」跃迁

en.summary: Seal amount (yuan) = bid-1 price × bid-1 volume. ★ Has a value only when bid-1 is at or above the limit-up price, otherwise NaN.
pitfalls: Absolute seal amounts are not comparable across market caps; usually pair it with SEAL_RATIO.
Only symbols in the order-book capture set have values; others are always NaN (comparisons fall back to false and never fire).
★ Evaluation still happens at bar close (once a minute): good for confirming the current state, not for catching a transition that just happened.

types.summary: 封单额/当日累计成交额，衡量封板厚度相对换手。
pitfalls: 分母是近似值（1m bar 汇总），不是交易所口径的累计成交额
只有进了盘口采集集的标的才有值，其余恒 NaN（比较兜底 false，不会误触发）
★ 求值频率目前仍是 bar 收盘（1/分钟），适合做「现在是什么状态」的确认，不适合捕捉「刚刚发生了什么」跃迁

en.summary: Seal amount / today's cumulative traded value: seal thickness relative to turnover.
pitfalls: The denominator is approximate (aggregated 1m bars), not the exchange's cumulative turnover.
Only symbols in the order-book capture set have values; others are always NaN (comparisons fall back to false and never fire).
★ Evaluation still happens at bar close (once a minute): good for confirming the current state, not for catching a transition that just happened.

types.summary: 封单额变化率（元/秒，最小二乘斜率）。★ 负值＝撤单出逃的第一信号。
pitfalls: 滑窗帧数是结构性缺省（约 10 秒），尚未标定
刚封板或刚回封时样本不足，返回 NaN
只有进了盘口采集集的标的才有值，其余恒 NaN（比较兜底 false，不会误触发）

en.summary: Rate of change of the seal amount (yuan per second, least-squares slope). ★ Negative = the first sign of cancellations and flight.
pitfalls: The sliding window length (about 10 seconds) is structural and not calibrated.
Right after sealing or resealing there are too few samples and it returns NaN.
Only symbols in the order-book capture set have values; others are always NaN (comparisons fall back to false and never fire).

types.summary: 看个股所属概念板块「今天强不强」，用于盘中顺势，不做逆势孤狼。
pitfalls: 分钟主周期上它是「昨日板块强度」，不是盘中实时强度（盘中板块数据源尚未接入）。
依赖同花顺概念数据同步；缺数据时为空，不是「板块弱」而是「没数据」
个股归属多个概念，取的是最强概念 z-score，可能掩盖其他概念拖累

en.summary: Whether the stock's concept sectors are strong today, to trade with the sector instead of alone against it.
pitfalls: On a minute primary timeframe it is yesterday's sector strength, not real-time (the intraday sector feed is not connected yet).
Depends on synced Tonghuashun concept data; empty means 'no data', not 'weak sector'.
A stock belongs to several concepts; the strongest concept's z-score is used, which can hide drag from the others.

params.description: 简单移动平均周期。用于该指标计算所回溯的 K 线根数（周期越大曲线越平滑、滞后越大）。

types.summary: 最近 N 根收盘价的算术平均，技术分析里最经典的均线指标。
pitfalls: 横盘震荡市场会被反复打脸，胜率可能跌到 30% 以下
周期越大滞后越严重——刚发出金叉时趋势往往已经走了一半
单独用 SMA 容易过拟合到回测期，实盘建议配合成交量或波动率过滤

en.summary: Arithmetic mean of the last N closes; the most classic moving average.
pitfalls: Ranging markets whipsaw it repeatedly; hit rates can fall below 30%.
Longer periods lag more — by the golden cross the trend is often half over.
SMA alone easily over-fits the backtest period; add volume or volatility filters for live use.

params.period: SMA period: number of bars looked back (larger is smoother and lags more).

types.summary: 买卖价差相对 mid 的 bps。涨停封死时没有卖盘，本就为 NaN。
pitfalls: 涨停/跌停封死时恒 NaN
只有进了盘口采集集的标的才有值，其余恒 NaN（比较兜底 false，不会误触发）
★ 求值频率目前仍是 bar 收盘（1/分钟），适合做「现在是什么状态」的确认，不适合捕捉「刚刚发生了什么」跃迁

en.summary: Bid-ask spread relative to mid, in bps. NaN when sealed at limit-up because there is no ask.
pitfalls: Always NaN when sealed at limit-up or limit-down.
Only symbols in the order-book capture set have values; others are always NaN (comparisons fall back to false and never fire).
★ Evaluation still happens at bar close (once a minute): good for confirming the current state, not for catching a transition that just happened.

params.description: 回看根数。

types.summary: 输入序列（缺省收盘价）最近 N 根的标准差，衡量波动大小。
pitfalls: 是价格单位，不同价位的股票不能直接比；要比用 ATR_PCT 或 BOLL 带宽

en.summary: Standard deviation of the input series (close by default) over the last N bars: size of fluctuations.
pitfalls: It is in price units and not comparable across price levels; use ATR_PCT or Bollinger bandwidth to compare.

types.summary: 三重平滑均线，比EMA更快更平滑，减少滞后。

TEMA's formula is complex and software differs; values vary across platforms, so do not copy others' parameters blindly.
It still lags, just less than EMA; it is still late on V-shaped reversals.

params.period: TEMA period: number of bars looked back (larger is smoother and lags more).

params.description: 用于计算均线斜率的快速均线，默认 MA5。

斜率 = (快线当前值 − 快线 N 根前值) / (N × ATR)，默认 5。
用 ATR 归一化斜率，使不同价格股票的趋势分可横向比较，默认 14。

types.summary: 综合衡量趋势方向性与价格位置合理性：斜率项（均线上升速度）减去偏离惩罚项（价格偏离均线程度）。
pitfalls: 该指标参数较多（4个），调参复杂，建议先用默认值验证有效性再微调

趋势健康度对快速反转行情反应慢（均线类指标天然滞后），不适合极短线

en.summary: Combines trend direction with how reasonable price's position is: a slope term (how fast the average rises) minus a deviation penalty (how far price is from the average).
pitfalls: It has four parameters and is complex to tune; validate with defaults before fine-tuning.
The first day after an A-share halt can produce an abnormal ATR; combine with a halt filter.
Reacts slowly to fast reversals (moving-average based); not for very short-term trading.

params.fast: Fast average used for the slope, MA5 by default.
params.slow: Base average for the deviation penalty: the further price is from it the larger the penalty; MA20 by default.
params.slopePeriod: Slope = (fast now − fast N bars ago) / (N × ATR); 5 by default.
params.atrPeriod: ATR period that normalises the slope so scores are comparable across price levels; 14 by default.

types.summary: 本次求值是不是被「大单主动买入」这条跃迁事件触发的。命中时返回该笔金额（元），于是可以直接写 TRIGGER_BIG_BUY() > 5000000；未命中为 NaN。

en.summary: Whether this evaluation was triggered by a 'large aggressive buy' transition event. Returns the trade value (yuan) when it was, so you can write TRIGGER_BIG_BUY() > 5000000; NaN otherwise.
pitfalls: ★ One-shot: holds only for the evaluation it triggered, not the next one.
Returns NaN, not 0, when not triggered — 0 would collide with 'amount is 0'.
Only evaluations driven by tick-by-tick transitions can match; under bar or order-book-frame driving it is always NaN.

pitfalls: Spreads each bar's volume evenly over its high-low range: an approximate volume profile.

Use with rule nodes TOUCH / BREAK / RECLAIM / RETEST: {"type":"BREAK","level":{"ind":"name"}}.

types.summary: 当日成交量与过去N日均量的比值，判断放量或缩量程度。
pitfalls: 突然的利好消息会导致倍量比瞬间飙升，但可能是散户跟风而非主力，次日容易回落
次新股或刚复牌股票的历史均量参考意义不大，倍量比容易失真
倍量比只反映相对放量程度，不区分主动买还是主动卖，需要结合价格方向判断

en.summary: Today's volume relative to the average of the past N days: how much volume expanded or contracted.
pitfalls: Sudden good news can spike it as retail piles in rather than large players; price often fades the next day.
For recent IPOs or stocks just back from a halt the historical average means little and the multiple is distorted.
It reflects relative volume only and does not distinguish aggressive buying from selling; combine with price direction.

params.period: Current bar volume / average volume of the previous N bars. 2.0 means twice the prior average.

params.description: 最近多少根 K 线作为承接段。
之前 N 根 K 线的成交量均值作为基准。

types.summary: 对比「近期成交量」与「更早一段均量」，判断关键价位是否有放量承接。
pitfalls: K 线根数不足时返回 0，不是「无承接」，而是数据不够——需保证 avgPeriod + recentBars 根历史
开盘首段均量常被竞价/集中成交扭曲，1m 策略可考虑跳过前 5–10 根
单一量比不能区分「主力承接」与「恐慌抛售」，需结合价格方向和其他 Layer 2 条件

en.summary: Compares recent volume with an earlier average to judge whether a key price level is absorbed on volume.
pitfalls: Returns 0 when there are not enough bars — that means insufficient data, not 'no support'; ensure avgPeriod + recentBars bars of history.
Average volume at the open is often distorted by the auction and concentrated trading; 1m strategies may skip the first 5–10 bars.
A single volume ratio cannot tell support buying from panic selling; combine with price direction and other conditions.

params.recentBars: Number of recent bars treated as the support segment.
params.avgPeriod: Average volume of the preceding N bars, used as the baseline.

params.description: 较近的一段，视为回落/回踩阶段，用于计算该段均量。
较早的一段，视为上涨/冲高阶段，作为量能对照基准。

types.summary: 比较「回踩段」与「冲高段」成交量，识别健康缩量回调还是放量出货。
pitfalls: 两段窗口顺序固定为「先 push 后 pullback」（时间轴上较早的是 push），参数设反会完全读错
总 K 线数需 ≥ pushBars + pullbackBars，否则结果不可靠
一字涨停或无量涨停后，均量极易失真，需人工排除极端行情

en.summary: Compares volume in the pullback segment with the push segment: a healthy low-volume pullback versus distribution on volume.
pitfalls: The segment order is fixed as push then pullback (push is earlier in time); swapping the parameters reads it completely wrong.
Total bars must be ≥ pushBars + pullbackBars, otherwise the result is unreliable.
After one-price or no-volume limit-ups the averages are easily distorted; exclude extreme cases manually.

params.pullbackBars: The more recent segment, treated as the pullback; its average volume is computed.
params.pushBars: The earlier segment, treated as the push; its volume is the baseline.

types.summary: 按涨跌幅加权的累计成交量，看量价是否配合。

VWAP does not predict direction, it only shows current cost; alone it invites chasing.

pitfalls: Extreme-volume days distort VWMA badly; one huge-volume day pulls it off and it takes days to recover.
On stocks with persistently shrinking volume VWMA is almost the same as SMA, adding complexity for nothing.
VWMA can lag more than SMA because heavy volume often comes at the end of a trend.

与昨收/开盘/最高/最低/均价比较时，「现价」取当根 K 线的哪个价。默认收盘价；判「盘中触及过」用最低价（回落）或最高价（反弹）。

types.summary: 现涨幅 − x 分钟前的涨幅（百分点，分母昨收）。

价格与主序列同一复权口径；百分比一律以昨收为分母。

en.summary: Current change − change x minutes ago (percentage points, previous close as denominator).
pitfalls: Needs a previous complete trading day: the first trading day in the series (cut by warm-up, usually incomplete) is always empty; warm-up counts as 3 trading days.
Prices use the same adjustment as the primary series; percentages always use the previous close as denominator.

params.minutes: The last x minutes of trading time (not a bar count); the window does not cross days, and when fewer than x minutes have passed since the open the start is the previous close. Must be a multiple of the primary timeframe in minutes (a 5m strategy can use 5, 10, 15 ...).
params.price: Which price of the current bar is 'current price' when comparing with previous close/open/high/low/average. Defaults to close; to test 'touched intraday' use low (pullback) or high (rebound).

基准取序列里此前多少个完整交易日（停牌日自然跳过）；凑不齐为空。暖机按 N + 2 个交易日折算。
SAME_TIME＝过去 N 日同一时段；PRIOR_WINDOWS＝今天此前 windows 个等长窗口。

en.summary: Volume over the last x minutes ÷ baseline.
pitfalls: Needs a previous complete trading day: the first trading day in the series (cut by warm-up, usually incomplete) is always empty.

params.minutes: The last x minutes of trading time. Must be a multiple of the primary timeframe in minutes.
params.days: Baseline uses this many previous complete trading days in the series (halted days are skipped); empty if not enough. Warm-up counts as N + 2 trading days.
params.baseline: SAME_TIME = the same time window over the past N days; PRIOR_WINDOWS = the previous `windows` equal-length windows today.
params.windows: Only with baseline=PRIOR_WINDOWS: how many earlier equal-length windows today form the baseline.

params.description: 加权移动平均周期。用于该指标计算所回溯的 K 线根数（周期越大曲线越平滑、滞后越大）。

types.summary: 给近期价格更高权重，比SMA更灵敏的均线。
pitfalls: 因为反应太快，在震荡行情里会比SMA产生更多假信号，频繁被洗
WMA的滞后性虽小于SMA，但依然存在，大周期（如60日）仍会慢半拍
权重分配方式固定，不一定适合所有股票或所有行情阶段

en.summary: Weights recent prices more; more responsive than SMA.
pitfalls: Because it reacts fast it gives more false signals than SMA in ranges and gets shaken out often.
WMA lags less than SMA but still lags; long periods (e.g. 60 days) are still late.
The weighting scheme is fixed and does not suit every stock or market phase.

params.period: WMA period: number of bars looked back (larger is smoother and lags more).

params.description: 当前值相对窗口均值的标准差倍数。

types.summary: 衡量价格偏离均值多少标准差，识别极端行情。
pitfalls: 在强趋势行情里 Z-Score 会一直大于 2 或小于 -2，做均值回归会被反复打脸，亏到怀疑人生
窗口期太短（如 5 天）Z-Score 容易剧烈跳动，信号频繁但假信号也多
不同股票的波动率差异大，Z-Score 绝对值 2 对某些股票可能是常态，对另一些才是极端

en.summary: How many standard deviations price is from its mean; spots extremes.
pitfalls: In strong trends the Z-Score stays above 2 or below −2; mean reversion gets punished repeatedly.
A short window (e.g. 5 days) is jumpy: frequent signals, many of them false.
Volatility differs by stock: |Z| = 2 is normal for some and extreme for others.

params.period: Number of standard deviations of the current value from the window mean.

params.description: 用于定位最近右侧连板结构的日线回看窗口。
窗口内需出现至少一段连续涨停日。
输出连板结束后至当前主周期盘中最高价 × (1 - 回撤阈值/100)。
连板结束后最多观察多少个日历日；0 表示不限制。
EXACT：恰好 N 连板；AT_LEAST：至少 N 连板，3 连板包含 4/5 连板。
涨停幅度默认按标的板块自动判断（主板 10、创业板/科创板 20、北交所 30）；只有「认不出标的」时才用这个值兜底。

types.summary: 涨停后盘中回撤线：标记连板股回调的警戒位。
pitfalls: 连板股一旦走「A 杀」（直接跌停出货），回撤线根本来不及反应，等触发时你已经亏了 20%+
这个指标只看价格回撤，不看成交量，有时候缩量回撤可能是洗盘，放量破线才是真危险
参数设置太敏感（比如回撤 10%）会频繁触发，全是假信号；太迟钝（比如 50%）又容易错过止损时机

en.summary: Marks the warning level for pullbacks in limit-up streak stocks.
pitfalls: When a streak stock collapses straight to limit-down, the line cannot react in time; by the trigger you may be down 20%+.
It looks at price drawdown only, not volume; a low-volume pullback may be a shakeout, while a high-volume break is the real danger.
Too sensitive (e.g. 10% drawdown) triggers constantly with false signals; too loose (e.g. 50%) misses the stop.

params.lookbackDays: Daily lookback window for locating the most recent limit-up streak.
params.minConsecutiveLimitUps: At least one run of consecutive limit-up days must occur in the window.
params.drawdownPct: Outputs the intraday high on the primary timeframe since the streak ended × (1 − drawdown threshold / 100).
params.maxPostStreakDays: Maximum calendar days to observe after the streak ends; 0 = unlimited.
params.matchMode: EXACT: exactly N in a row; AT_LEAST: at least N, so a 3-day match includes 4- and 5-day streaks.
params.limitPct: The limit size is detected from the symbol's board by default (main board 10, ChiNext/STAR 20, Beijing 30); this value is only a fallback when the symbol cannot be recognised.

params.description: 按上海时区 trade_date 对齐的日线回看窗口；数据以 md_bars_1d 为主，近期缺口可由 1m 按 trade_date 回填。与交易所精细日历可能不完全一致。
窗口内需出现至少一段连续涨停日（相对前一日收盘涨幅 ≥ limitPct%）。
当前主周期收盘价相对连板结束后至当前的盘中最高价回撤不低于该百分比。
连板结束后最多观察多少个日历日；0 表示不限制。
EXACT：恰好 N 连板；AT_LEAST：至少 N 连板，3 连板包含 4/5 连板。
默认（POST_STREAK_MEAN）：最右侧连板结束日次日起至当前的日均成交量不低于窗口内日量峰值 × 该比例/100。LAST_DAY 模式下为最后一日量不低于此前各日最大日量 × 该比例/100。
POST_STREAK_MEAN：涨停后区间日均量相对窗口峰值；LAST_DAY：仅比较最后一日。连板持续到当前且没有涨停后区间时 POST_STREAK_MEAN 量能不通过。
涨停幅度默认按标的板块自动判断（主板 10、创业板/科创板 20、北交所 30）；只有「认不出标的」时才用这个值兜底。

types.summary: 捕捉连板股回调后的二次拉升机会。
pitfalls: 连板股一旦回调，可能直接A杀，黄金坑变成无底洞，必须严格设置止损
回撤阈值设得太小容易频繁触发假信号，设得太大可能错过最佳买点
成交量萎缩条件在极端行情下可能失效，比如一字板跌停无量，但后续继续跌停

en.summary: Captures the second leg up after a limit-up streak stock pulls back.
pitfalls: A pulled-back streak stock can collapse straight down and the 'golden pit' becomes bottomless; strict stops are mandatory.
A small drawdown threshold fires false signals often; a large one may miss the best entry.
The volume-contraction condition can fail in extreme cases, e.g. a no-volume limit-down followed by further limit-downs.

params.lookbackDays: Daily lookback aligned to trade_date in Shanghai time; data comes mainly from md_bars_1d, with recent gaps backfilled from 1m bars by trade_date. May not match the exchange calendar exactly.
params.minConsecutiveLimitUps: At least one run of consecutive limit-up days (gain vs previous close ≥ limitPct%) must occur in the window.
params.drawdownPct: The current close on the primary timeframe must be at least this percent below the intraday high since the streak ended.
params.maxPostStreakDays: Maximum calendar days to observe after the streak ends; 0 = unlimited.
params.matchMode: EXACT: exactly N in a row; AT_LEAST: at least N, so a 3-day match includes 4- and 5-day streaks.
params.volumePctOfMax: Default (POST_STREAK_MEAN): average daily volume from the day after the last streak ends until now must be at least the window's peak daily volume × this ratio / 100. In LAST_DAY mode the last day's volume must be at least the largest earlier daily volume × this ratio / 100.
params.volumeMode: POST_STREAK_MEAN: average daily volume after the limit-ups relative to the window peak; LAST_DAY: compare only the last day. If the streak lasts until now with no post-streak period, POST_STREAK_MEAN fails the volume check.
params.limitPct: The limit size is detected from the symbol's board by default (main board 10, ChiNext/STAR 20, Beijing 30); this value is only a fallback when the symbol cannot be recognised.
